blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27--29\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. This loss of initial successes is substantially larger than under fixed-order repetition, even for highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)中的选择偏差尽管指示忽略演示顺序或提示引出推理,但仍能持续. 最近为复制Jev风格系统而作的努力 一种行为产生了越来越多的模型,可以直接预测所提供候选人的概率。 然而,在多选项任务中,对Jev版本、Jev复制版和遗传性LLMs的选择偏好进行的系统比较仍然有限。 这留下了一个中心问题:Jev式的决策结构是否减少了选择偏差? 我们用一个简单的测试来处理这个问题,这种测试在排除各种选择的同时,使问题和候选人的内容保持不变。 通过两个Jev版本,十二个Jev复制, 以及六个遗传性LLM, 我们通过八个演示来追踪单个答案, 并将其与固定顺序的重复进行比较。 在我们从两个基准中初步收集出1700个问题时,Jev的准确度相差不到2个百分点,然而其累积失败设定比起最初的顺序扩大了27-29分,最初的失败持续到最后的表述. 最初的成功损失大大超过固定顺序的重复损失,即使是极可重复的Jev复制。 Jev在保留正确的选择方面也没有表现出比LLM基线的一般优势. 汇总提供了有限的保护:投票给Jev带来的收益不大,而即使是一致的答复也常常是错误的. 这些结果暴露出可重复的决定与同等列报中仍然正确的决定之间的差距,表明为什么仅靠稳定的准确性无法对选择偏差产生阻力。

The reproductions achieve 97.7–100% same-candidate agreement under original-order repetition but lose 23.2–64.2% of initial successes under reordering.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A correct choice should depend on candidate content, yet language models can change their answers when only the presentation changes. Reordering options can alter multiple-choice answers ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , and swapping two unchanged responses can reverse an LLM judge’s preference ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . Such selection bias lets presentation influence a decision without adding evidence about which candidate is correct. A question answered correctly in one order may therefore fail in another.
blocks.zh: 正确的选择应该取决于候选内容,然而语言模型只有在演示文稿改变时才能改变答案. 重排选项可以改变多种选择的答案(Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024;Zheng等人, 2024),互换两个不变的答案可以逆转LM法官的偏好(Wang等人, 2023;Zheng等人, 2023;Song等人, 2025). 这种选择的偏差使提交方式对决定产生影响,而不增加哪些候选人是正确的证据。 因此,一个问题按一个顺序正确回答,另一个顺序就可能失败。

blocks.en: Prompting alone does not reliably remove this bias. Zheng et al. (2024) find residual bias under explicit debiasing instructions and chain-of-thought prompting in the settings tested. Calibration and targeted training offer ways to reduce it ( Li et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , while evidence from multi-document question answering suggests that reasoning models can be less position-biased ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Selection bias is therefore sensitive to how a model is trained and used. This raises the possibility that models designed expressly for candidate selection could better preserve their decisions.
blocks.zh: 光是煽动并不能可靠地消除这种偏见。 Zheng等人(2024年)发现,在经过测试的环境下,根据明确的偏离指令和思维链,存在残留偏差。 校准和定向培训提供了减少的方法(Li等人,2024年;Xue等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2026年),而多文件问题回答的证据表明推理模型可以降低位置偏见(Li等人,2026年). 因此,选择偏颇对如何培训和使用模型很敏感。 这就有可能使为甄选候选人而专门设计的模型能够更好地保存其决定。

blocks.en: Jev-style System One models make this possibility concrete. They predict a probability distribution directly over candidates supplied with each request. TypeSafe describes Jev as trained for calibrated decisions through Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD). 1 1 1 TypeSafe’s model introduction and machine-learning primer describe this training goal; the complete architecture and training recipe remain proprietary. Recent efforts to reproduce this behavior have produced a growing family of models ( Geuter et al., 2026 ; Li and Wagle, 2026 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , which we call Jev reproductions . These implementations range from training a decision head with backbone adaptation to extracting candidate probabilities from a frozen LLM. The term denotes a shared behavioral goal, without implying recovery of Jev’s proprietary internals or a common architecture. Candidate representation, probability readout, and decision-specific learning are therefore possible sources of robustness, not guarantees of it.
blocks.zh: Jev 风格系统 一种模式使得这种可能性变得具体。 他们预测,根据每项要求,候选人的概率可直接分配。 类型安全描述 Jev通过校准决定强化学习(RLCD)接受校准决定培训。 1 1 TypeSafe的模型介绍和机器学习入门描述这一培训目标;完整的架构和培训配方仍然是专有的。 最近为复制这种行为所做的努力产生了越来越多的模型家族(Geuter等人,2026年;Li and Wagle,2026年;Zhuang等人,2026年),我们称之为Jev复制. 这些执行情况包括培训决策者并进行骨干改造,以及从冻结的LLM中提取候选人的概率。 这个术语表示共同的行为目标,但不意味着Jev的专有内部或共同架构的恢复. 因此,候选人代表、概率读取和具体决策的学习可能是稳健的来源,而不是保证。

blocks.en: Existing evidence already challenges the assumption that structured decisions resist bias. Typed decision models can repeat pairwise judgments reliably yet reverse them when the two responses are swapped ( Lukassen et al., 2026 ) . In public Jev-style implementations, option labels can override written definitions, and serialization changes can alter this behavior with model weights fixed ( Azizi et al., 2026 ) . What remains limited is a systematic comparison of Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs as correct choices face repeated reordering in multi-option tasks. A single swap cannot reveal how widely failures spread over further orders, and aggregate accuracy can hide losses that recoveries offset. We therefore ask: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias?
blocks.zh: 现有证据已经对结构化决定抵制偏见的假设提出质疑。 输入式决定模型可以可靠地重复对等判断,但当两个答复互换时却可以逆转(Lukassen等人,2026年)。 在公共Jev风格的实现中,选项标签可以凌驾于书面定义之上,序列化的改变可以用模型加权固定来改变这种行为(Azizi等人,2026年). 仍然有限的是系统比较Jev版本,Jev复制,以及基因的LLMs作为正确选择在多选项任务中面临反复的重排. 单一的互换无法揭示失败在进一步订单中的广泛分布,而总的准确性可以掩盖可以抵消损失的损失。 因此,我们问:Jev式的决策结构是否减少选择偏差?

blocks.en: We investigate this question with a simple test that shuffles options while preserving question and candidate content. The study compares two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs on SuperGPQA ( M-A-P et al., 2025 ) , LEXam ( Fan et al., 2026 ) , MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and GPQA Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) . Our primary collection pools 1,700 questions from SuperGPQA and LEXam. For each question, we compare the original order, its reversal, and six random permutations with eight requests in the unchanged original order. Tracking first errors reveals how the failure set expands and how many initial successes survive. Every request retains the full candidate menu.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个简单的测试来调查这个问题,该测试在保留问题和候选人内容的同时,可以排除各种选择。 该研究比较了两个Jev版本,十二个Jev复制,和六个关于SuperGPQA(M-A-P等人,2025年),LEXam(Fan等人,2026年),MMLU-Pro(Wang等人,2024年)和GPQA Diamond(Rein等人,2023年)的基因LLMs. 我们的初选集汇集了1700个来自超级GPQA和LEXam的问题. 对于每个问题,我们比较了原顺序,其倒置,以及六个随机排列,与原顺序不变的八个请求. 跟踪第一个错误揭示了失败设置是如何扩大的,以及有多少初始成功存活下来的. 每一份申请都保留完整的候选菜单.

blocks.en: The test reveals no general Jev advantage in preserving correct choices. Jev’s accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27–29%, with first failures continuing into the final presentation (Figure 1 ). Four LLMs preserve more initial successes, including on questions every model initially answers correctly. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash have lower pooled retention, preventing a universal ranking of model families. The central finding is that Jev’s structured decision formulation does not by itself protect answers the model can already get right.
blocks.zh: 测试显示Jev在保留正确选择方面没有普遍优势. Jev的准确度差不到两个百分点,但其累积失败率却上升了27-29%,最初的失败率持续到最后的表述(图1 ). 四个LLMs保存了更多的初步成功,包括每个模型最初正确回答的问题. Qune3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash的集合保留率较低,阻碍了模范家庭的普遍排名. 中心结论是,Jev结构化决策的制定本身并不能保护模型已经正确得到的答案。

blocks.en: Fixed-order repetition exposes a second distinction: repeatability does not ensure robustness to reordering. Jev repeats choices more consistently than several LLMs, but loses substantially more initial successes under reordering than under repetition at the same call budget. The twelve Jev reproductions make this gap especially clear: 97.7–100% fixed-order agreement coexists with losses of 23.2–64.2% of initial successes under reordering (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 固定顺序重复暴露了第二个区别:重复性不能保证强力重排. Jev比几个有限责任公司更一贯地重复选择,但在重新排序下损失的初始成功远远多于在同一呼吁预算中的重复。 十二次Jev复制特别清楚地表明了这一差距:97.7-100%的固定订单协议与23.2-64.2%的最初重组成功率(图2)同时存在。

blocks.en: The remaining analyses examine where correct choices are most fragile and whether repeated answers can repair them. Difficulty and menu-size comparisons locate this vulnerability. MMLU-Pro and GPQA Diamond show that it persists where Jev achieves higher accuracy and with only four candidates. Voting offers only modest gains for Jev, and unanimity still admits frequent errors. Together, these results distinguish average accuracy, fixed-order repeatability, and preservation of correct choices. The supporting survey in Appendices A – I organizes differences in representation, learning, and computation that controlled comparisons could isolate to explain the observed behavior.
blocks.zh: 其余的分析审查哪些正确的选择最脆弱,重复回答是否能够修复这些选择。 难以和菜单大小的比较可以找到这种脆弱性。 MMLU-Pro和GPQA Diamond显示,在Jev获得更高准确度且只有4名候选人的地方,它持续存在. 投票给Jev只带来微薄的收益,而全体一致仍然承认经常的错误。 这些结果共同区分了平均准确性、固定顺序的重复性和对正确选择的维护。 附录A中的支持性调查 — — 我组织在代表性、学习和计算方面的差异,控制性比较可以隔离以解释观察到的行为。

blocks.en: 2 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 2 评价设置

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation uses a fixed collection of 1,700 test questions: 1,200 from SuperGPQA ( M-A-P et al., 2025 ) and 500 from LEXam ( Fan et al., 2026 ) . 2 2 2 Dataset releases: SuperGPQA and LEXam . The benchmarks cover graduate-level knowledge and legal examination questions. We weight questions equally, so pooled scores reflect this sample composition rather than an equal-weight average of benchmark scores.
blocks.zh: 我们的初级评价使用固定的1700个测试题集:1200个来自SuperGPQA(M-A-P等人,2025年),500个来自LEXam(Fan等人,2026年). 2 2 数据集发布:SuperGPQA和LEXam. 这些基准包括研究生一级的知识和法律考试问题。 我们对问题进行同等的加权,所以集合分数反映了这种样本构成,而不是基准分数的相等加权平均值.

blocks.en: SuperGPQA contributes questions with 4–10 options from its official evaluation release, balanced across easy, middle, and hard difficulty. LEXam contributes 125 test questions at each of 4, 8, 16, and 32 options. This collection supports analyses by difficulty, discipline, and candidate count. Candidate count varies with benchmark and question content, so these comparisons are descriptive.
blocks.zh: SuperGPQA提供4 -10选项, LEXam在4,8,16和32个选项中各提供125个测试问题. 这份汇编支持通过困难、纪律和候选人计数进行分析。 候选人的计数因基准和问题内容而异,因此这些比较是描述性的.

blocks.en: Two further datasets test the scope of the findings. MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) contributes 300 test questions, with 100 each at eight, nine, and ten options and 21–22 from each of fourteen subjects. GPQA Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) contributes all 198 questions, each with four options. 3 3 3 Dataset releases: MMLU-Pro and GPQA , Diamond subset. We report these datasets separately to examine whether the vulnerability persists at higher Jev accuracy and with short candidate menus. The balanced MMLU-Pro sample does not estimate accuracy over the full benchmark distribution. All question sets remain fixed across models and presentations.
blocks.zh: 另有两个数据集测试了调查结果的范围。 MMLU-Pro(Wang et al., 2024)提供300个测试问题,其中8,9,14个科目各有100个选项和21–22个选项. GPQA Diamond(Rein等人,2023年)提供了全部198个问题,每个问题都有四个选项. 3 3 数据集发布:MMLU-Pro和GPQA,钻石子集. 我们分别报告这些数据集,以审查脆弱性是否继续存在,其准确性较高,而且候选人菜单短。 平衡的MMLU-Pro样本不能估计全部基准分布的准确性。 所有问题集在模型和演示中保持不变。

blocks.en: 2.2 Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 模式

blocks.en: The Jev--LLM comparison includes Jev 1.13 and Jev 1.14, with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-sol, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and GLM-5.3-Flash as generative LLM baselines. 4 4 4 Model documentation: Jev , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 , Claude Sonnet 5.5 , Qwen3.8-Flash-Next , Gemini 3.8 Flash , and GLM-5.3-Flash . Jev returns a choice through its native decision interface. The LLMs receive a serialized representation of the same question and candidate menu and return a selection. Their training, inference procedures, and interfaces are not matched.
blocks.zh: Jev-LLM比较包括Jev 1.13和Jev 1.14,以DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,Claude Sonnet 5.5,GPT-6.1-sol,Qune3.8-Flash-Next,双子座3.8 Flash,GLM-5.3-Flash作为基因LLM基线. 4 4 4 示范文件: 杰维, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,克劳德·索内特5.5,Quen3.8-Flash-Next,双子座3.8 Flash,以及GLM-5.3-Flash. Jev通过其本地决定界面返回一个选择. LLMs收到同一问题和候选菜单的序列化表述,并返回一个选择. 他们的训练、推论程序和接口不匹配。

blocks.en: The comparison with Jev reproductions includes AutoTrust-JEV-9B, AutoTrust-JEV-27B, AutoTrust-JEV-35B, AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1, AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B, StartLux-Decision-v1-0.8B, StartLux-Decision-v1-2B, StartLux-Decision-v1-4B, StartLux-Decision-v1-9B, StartLux-Decision-v1-27B, StartLux-Decision-v1-35B-A3B ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , and pplx-decider-v1.1-27b. 5 5 5 Official model cards: AutoTrust-JEV-27B , AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B , and pplx-decider-v1.1-27b . We select the candidate with the highest native probability, without generating an answer or using deliberation. Both Jev versions serve as references, giving twenty unique models across the two comparisons. Every model is evaluated on all four datasets. Unsupported menus and absent selections count as incorrect. Candidate-identity statistics require actual selections and use the fixed sets defined below.

( Zhu等,2026),和pplx-decider-v1.1-27b. 5 5 官方型号卡: AutoTrust-JEV-27B, AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B, 和 pplx-decider-v1.1-27b. 我们选择候选人的本土概率最高,不产生答案或考虑。 Jev两种版本都作为参考,在两种比较中给出了20种独特的模型. 所有四个数据集都对每个模型进行评价。 不支持的菜单和缺选都算错 。 候选人身份统计需要实际选择,并使用以下定义的固定数据集。

blocks.en: 2.3 Eight Presentations of Each Question
blocks.zh: 2.3 每个问题的八次陈述

blocks.en: Across all four datasets, each question is presented in its original candidate order, the reversed order, and six random permutations. All models receive the same permutation for a given question. Each candidate’s identifier moves with its content, preserving their association, while the question and state remain unchanged. Every request retains the full menu. These are repeated measurements of fixed questions. In the primary collection, the first random permutation differs from the original, and each subsequent random permutation differs from all preceding permutations. MMLU-Pro has eight distinct orders per question, while GPQA Diamond has seven or eight.
blocks.zh: 在所有四个数据集中,每个问题都按其原始候选顺序,倒置顺序,以及六个随机排列排列. 所有型号都为特定问题得到相同的布置. 每个候选人的识别特征随其内容而移动,保留其联系,而问题和状态保持不变。 每个请求保留完整的菜单. 这些是对固定问题的反复测量。 在主集中,第一个随机的演化与原作不同,每个后续的随机演化与所有之前的演化不同. MMLU-Pro每个问题有8个不同的订单,而GPQA Diamond则有7个或8个.

blocks.en: The intervention changes the order of candidate entries without independently manipulating identifiers or rewriting answers. The original presentation provides a reference for trajectories; it is not assumed to be the least biased order. Requests are independent: later presentations do not include earlier model answers.
blocks.zh: 介入会改变候选条目的顺序,而不会独立操纵标识符或重写答案. 最初的表述为轨迹提供了参考;不被认为是最小偏差的顺序. 请求是独立的:以后的演示文稿不包括早期的模型解答.

blocks.en: We request low reasoning effort for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, GPT-6.1-sol, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and GLM-5.3-Flash, and use adaptive thinking with low effort for Claude Sonnet 5.5. Returned keys are mapped back to the original candidates. Moving a candidate to a different position does not count as a changed decision if the model selects the same candidate.
blocks.zh: 我们要求对DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,GPT-6.1-sol,Qune3.8-Flash-Next,双子座3.8 Flash,以及GLM-5.3-Flash进行低度推理,对克劳德·索内5.5使用低度努力的适应性思维. 返回的密钥被映射回原候选人. 如果模型选择同一候选人,将候选人调到不同职位并不算作改变的决定。

blocks.en: 2.4 Repeated Requests in the Original Order
blocks.zh: 2.4 原命令中重复的请求

blocks.en: The original-order repetition study holds candidate content, identifiers, and order fixed across eight independent requests for every model: the original presentation and seven further requests. No request receives an earlier answer. Following the distinction between repetition stability and position consistency in Shi et al. (2025) , this condition measures fixed-order repeatability through same-candidate agreement across requests.

blocks.en: We reuse the eight recorded selections to examine whether agreement provides useful evidence of correctness. Plurality voting selects the most frequently chosen actual candidate, without requiring an absolute majority. Missing selections cast no vote, and a question with no votes counts as incorrect. For ties, we report expected correctness under a uniform draw among the tied candidates. This rule favors neither the original presentation nor the gold answer. We compare voting with mean single-presentation accuracy on the same set 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} : the paired set for the Jev–LLM comparison and the full collection for the comparison with Jev reproductions. The difference measures the gain from combining eight answers rather than using one of the eight with equal probability.

We report these quantities together because higher conditional accuracy can come at the cost of answering fewer questions. These are post-hoc analyses of the observed responses, without a new evaluation sample. Voting under original-order repetition also uses eight calls for every model (Section 2.4 ).

blocks.en: 3 Does Jev Resist Changes in Option Order?

blocks.en: The central question concerns the survival of correct choices, not just the stability of a score. We first trace the failures hidden by aggregate accuracy, then compare their extent with LLM baselines and with fixed-order repetition.
blocks.zh: 核心问题涉及正确选择的生存,而不仅仅是得分的稳定性。 我们首先通过集合精度来追踪隐藏的故障,然后将其程度与LLM基线和固定顺序重复进行比较.

blocks.en: 3.1 What Stable Accuracy Conceals
blocks.zh: 3.1 稳定准确性

blocks.en: All eight models in the Jev–LLM comparison maintain similar accuracy across presentations despite substantial differences in their overall performance. Jev scores near 50%, spanning only 1.47 percentage points for version 1.13 and 1.53 for version 1.14. The LLMs score approximately 56–72%, with similarly narrow ranges of 1.12–2.59 points (Figure 1 (a)).
blocks.zh: Jev-LLM比较中的所有8个模型,尽管其总体性能有很大差异,却在各种演示中保持了类似的准确性. Jev的得分接近50%,1.13版的得分只有1.47个百分点,1.14版的得分只有1.53个百分点. LLMs的得分约为56-72%,类似窄度为1.12-2.59分(图1(a))。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Accuracy hides changes in individual choices. Original-to-reversed transitions on paired questions: (a) correct to wrong, (b) wrong to correct, (c) wrong to a different wrong candidate, and (d) all changed choices. Opposing transitions can cancel in accuracy; changes between wrong candidates leave it unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图3:准确性掩盖了个人选择的变化. 在对偶的问题上,原有到反向过渡:(a) 正确到错误,(b) 错误到错误,(c) 错误到不同的错误候选人,(d) 所有选择都改变了。 反对的过渡可以取消准确性;错误候选人之间的变动则保持不变.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Accuracy also hides turnover in Jev reproductions. Reversal transitions on each model’s fixed identity set, using the categories in Figure 3 . AutoTrust-JEV-9B loses 167 correct answers and recovers 170, while another 377 choices move between wrong candidates.
blocks.zh: 图4:准确性也隐藏了Jev复制中的营业额. 使用图3中的类别,在每个模型的固定身份设定上进行逆向过渡。 AutoTrust-JEV-9B损失167个正确答案并回收170个,而另外377个选择在错误的候选人之间移动.

blocks.en: Jev 1.14 illustrates this cancellation under reversal (Figure 3 ): 103 correct answers become wrong and 106 wrong answers become correct, yielding a net gain of three. Another 143 choices move between wrong candidates, bringing the total to 352 changed decisions. GPT-6.1-sol gains nine correct answers while changing 149 selections: 48 losses, 57 recoveries, and 44 wrong-to-wrong switches. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash change 416 and 541 decisions for net gains of only 13 and 17. Similar score changes thus conceal different amounts of turnover, including failures on questions each model could previously answer.
blocks.zh: Jev 1.14 说明这种在逆转下取消(图3):103正确答案变为错误,106错误答案变为正确,净收益为3. 另有143个选择在错误的候选人之间移动,使总共352个决定发生变化。 GPT-6.1-溶液得到9个正确答案,同时改变149个选择:48个损失,57个回收,44个错对错开关。 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash变更416和541决定,净收益仅为13和17. 因此,类似的分数变化掩盖了不同的营业额,包括每个模型以前可以回答的问题的失败。

blocks.en: The same cancellation occurs in Jev reproductions (Figure 4 ). AutoTrust-JEV-9B loses 167 correct answers and recovers 170, while another 377 choices switch between wrong candidates. Its 714 changed decisions yield a net gain of three correct answers. Across all eight presentations, the twelve Jev reproductions’ accuracy ranges are only 1.12–2.18 points (Figure 2 (a)). Stable aggregate performance therefore offers little evidence that individual decisions are preserved.
blocks.zh: 同样的取消发生在Jev复制(图4 ). AutoTrust-JEV-9B损失167个正确答案,回收170个,而另外377个选择在错误的候选人之间切换. 其714项改变的决定产生了三个正确答案的净收益。 在所有8个演示中,12个Jev复制的精度范围只有1.12-2.18分(图2(a))。 因此,稳定的总体业绩没有多少证据表明个别决定得到了保留。

blocks.en: 3.2 First Failures Continue Beyond the Initial Presentations
blocks.zh: 3.2 首次失败在初步陈述之后继续

blocks.en: Jev 1.13 fails on 755 questions in the original presentation and on 961 across all eight, while Jev 1.14 rises from 746 to 965 (Figure 1 (c)). The additional 206 and 219 questions expand the observed failure sets by 27.3% and 29.4%, despite the narrow accuracy ranges. The LLMs also expose new failures, ranging from 111 for GPT-6.1-sol to 414 for GLM-5.3-Flash, with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and GLM-5.3-Flash exceeding Jev. Absolute additions alone do not establish a robustness ranking, however, because models begin with different numbers of correct answers available to lose.
blocks.zh: Jev 1.13在最初的演示文稿中失败了755个问题,961在全部8个问题上失败了,而Jev 1.14则从746升至965(图1(c)). 另外206和219个问题将观测到的故障装置扩大了27.3%和29.4%,尽管准确度范围很窄。 LLMS也暴露了新的故障,从GPT-6.1-sol的111次到GLM-5.3-Flash的414次不等,其中DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017次,Qune3.8-Flash-Next次,以及GLM-5.3-Flash超过Jev. 单是绝对加法并不能确定稳健性排名,因为模型开始有不同数量的正确答案可以输.

blocks.en: First failures continue well beyond the initial reversal. Reversal exposes 96 and 103 for the two Jev versions; the eighth presentation still reveals seven and eight questions answered correctly in all seven preceding presentations. The LLMs add 7–32 first failures in that round, with GLM-5.3-Flash adding the most. Cumulative counts are nondecreasing by definition. The empirical finding is the scale of the expansion and the continued loss of questions that have already survived several orders.
blocks.zh: 最初的失败远远超出最初的逆转。 Reversal为两个Jev版本披露了96和103;第八次演示仍然披露了前七次演示中正确回答的7和8个问题. LLMs在该回合中增加了7–32的首个失败,其中GLM-5.3-Flash最多. 从定义上讲,累积数是没有减少的。 经验结论是扩张的规模和已经幸存下来的若干问题的持续损失.

blocks.en: All twelve Jev reproductions likewise expose first failures in the eighth presentation, adding 3–14 per model (Figure 2 (c)). Even AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1, which has comparatively favorable retention, expands from 887 failed questions in the original order to 1,076 across the sequence, with 11 first failures in the final presentation.
blocks.zh: 所有十二种Jev复制同样都暴露了第八次演示中的第一个失败,增加了每个模型的3-14(图2(c))。 甚至AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1也具有相对偏好的保留,从原序的887个失败问题扩大到了全序的1,076个,最后的演示有11个首个失败.

blocks.en: 3.3 Persistence on Shared Initial Successes
blocks.zh: 3.3 坚持共享初步成功

blocks.en: Retention normalizes the same first-failure expansion by the number of initial successes, since B 8 − B 1 = | C 1 | ( 1 − R 8 ) B_{8}-B_{1}=|C_{1}|(1-R_{8}) . Across all eight presentations, Jev retains 73.2–74.5% of its initially correct answers, compared with 77.2–90.2% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash, 66.1% for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and 53.7% for GLM-5.3-Flash (Figure 1 (d)). Equivalently, 25.5–26.8% of Jev’s initial successes fail at least once. The structured interface does not prevent this loss, while Qwen3.8-Flash-Next’s and GLM-5.3-Flash’s lower retention rule out a blanket Jev–LLM ranking.
blocks.zh: 保留使相同的第一次失败扩展正常化,因为最初的成功次数是B8 − B1 = QQ C 1 → (1 − R 8) B_{8 }-B_{1 → C_{1 → (1-R_{8)). 在所有8个介绍中,Jev保留了73.2-74.5%的最初正确答案,而DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017、Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、双子座3.8 Flash、Qune3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash分别为73.2-90.2%和53.7%(图1(d))。 Jev最初的成功率有25.5-26.8%至少一次失败。 结构化接口无法防止这一损失,而Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's和GLM-5.3-Flash的低保值排除了毛毯Jev-LLM排名.

blocks.en: This comparison could be affected by which questions each model answers correctly in the first place. We therefore repeat it on the shared initial-correct set, requiring every model to begin with a correct answer to every included question. Jev 1.13 and Jev 1.14 retain 85.4% and 84.4%, respectively. Retention reaches 93.1% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, 96.3% for Claude Sonnet 5.5, 98.3% for GPT-6.1-sol, and 97.9% for Gemini 3.8 Flash. GPT-6.1-sol’s paired advantage is 12.9 percentage points over Jev 1.13 (95% interval 9.6–16.2) and 13.9 over Jev 1.14 (10.6–17.3). The DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Gemini 3.8 Flash intervals also exclude zero. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next retains 85.2%, with differences of − 0.2 -0.2 points from Jev 1.13 ( − 4.4 -4.4 –3.7) and 0.8 from Jev 1.14 ( − 3.5 -3.5 –5.0); neither interval establishes a difference. GLM-5.3-Flash retains only 70.5%, below both Jev versions, with both paired intervals excluding zero.
blocks.zh: 这种比较可能会影响每个模型首先正确回答的问题。 因此,我们在共同的初始正确套件上重复一遍,要求每个模型首先正确回答每个包含的问题。 Jev 1.13和Jev 1.14分别保留85.4%和84.4%. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017的留成率达到93.1%,克劳德·索内特5.5的留成率为96.3%,GPT-6.1-sol的留成率为98.3%,双子座3.8 Flash的留成率为97.9%. GPT-6.1-sol的配对优势比Jev1.13(95%间隔9.6-16.2)高12.9个百分点,比Jev1.14(10.6-17.3)高13.9个百分点. 深赛克-V4.1-Flash-1017,克劳德·索内5.5,双子座3.8 闪光间隔也排除0. Qune3.8-Flash-Next保留85.2%,与Jev 1.13(−4.4-4.4–3.7)的比分为−0.2–0.2分,与Jev 1.14(−3.5–3.5–5.0)的比分为0.8分;两者的间隔均不能确定差异. GLM-5.3-Flash只保留了70.5%,低于两个Jev版本,两个配对间隔均排除0.

blocks.en: Matching initial successes therefore preserves Jev’s disadvantage relative to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash, while bringing Qwen3.8-Flash-Next close to Jev and leaving GLM-5.3-Flash below it. This comparison controls which questions enter the calculation, without matching model capability, training, or variation under repeated requests.
blocks.zh: 因此,与初步成功相匹配可保持 Jev相对于DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,Claude Sonnet 5.5,GPT-6.1-sol,和双子座3.8 Flash的劣势,同时将Qune3.8-Flash-Next带近Jev,并将GLM-5.3-Flash留在其下方. 这种比较控制在不匹配模型能力、培训或重复请求下的变异的情况下质疑输入计算。

blocks.en: Retention also varies widely within the decision-model family. Under full-collection scoring, AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 loses 23.2% of initial successes, below the Jev reference losses of 27.0% and 27.8%. The other eleven reproductions lose 30.0–64.2%, including 30.0% for pplx-decider-v1.1-27b and 49.5% for AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B. Native candidate prediction thus supports implementations on both sides of the Jev results. These rates condition on each model’s own initial successes, so their spread also reflects differences in the questions each model initially answers correctly.
blocks.zh: 保留在决策模式家庭中也有很大差异。 在全收积分下,AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1损失了23.2%的初始成功率,低于Jev参考损失27.0%和27.8%. 其他11种复制损失30.0–64.2%,包括pplx-decider-v1.1-27b的30.0%和AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B的49.5%. 因此,原生候选人预测支持在Jev结果的两侧执行。 这些速率条件取决于每个模型本身的初步成功,因此其分布也反映了每个模型最初正确回答的问题的差异.

blocks.en: 3.4 Repeatability Under a Fixed Order
blocks.zh: 3.4 根据固定命令的可重复性

blocks.en: The preceding trajectories vary both the request and the candidate order. Holding the order fixed reveals a different comparison (Figure 1 (b)). Over eight original-order requests, Jev 1.13 and Jev 1.14 achieve 85.0% and 84.4% same-candidate agreement. Both exceed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and GLM-5.3-Flash. GPT-6.1-sol reaches 86.2%, while Gemini 3.8 Flash’s 84.7% lies between the Jev versions. GLM-5.3-Flash’s agreement falls to 44.5% even without a menu change. Thus, variability across reordered presentations includes variation that can already occur under repetition, and its extent differs substantially across models.
blocks.zh: 前面的轨迹既不同请求,也不同候选顺序. 持有固定的订单显示不同的比较(图1(b))。 超过8项原订单请求,Jev 1.13和Jev 1.14达成85.0%和84.4%的同名合同协议. 两者都超过了DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,克劳德·索内5.5,Qune3.8-Flash-Next,以及GLM-5.3-Flash. GPT-6.1-溶液达到86.2%,而双子座3.8 Flash的84.7%位于Jev版本之间. GLM-5.3-Flash协议即使没有修改菜单也降至44.5%. 因此,重新排列的列报方式的可变性包括重复情况下可能已经发生的差异,其程度在各模型之间差别很大。

blocks.en: High repeatability also includes repeated mistakes (Figure 5 ). Across eight original-order requests, 36.8–38.0% of all paired questions receive the same wrong Jev answer throughout, and accuracy among its unanimous answers is only 55.4–56.4%. A stable choice therefore provides limited assurance of correctness.
blocks.zh: 高可重复性还包括重复的错误(图5 )。 在8项原订申请中,36.8-38.0%的所有对联问题在整个过程中都得到同样的错误的Jev回答,其一致答复的准确性仅为55.4-56.4%. 因此,稳定的选择提供了有限的正确性保证。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Jev’s fixed-order agreement includes repeated errors. Eight original-order requests: (a) mean accuracy, (b) agreement across all eight, (c) loss of initial successes, and (d) questions with the same wrong answer throughout. Panels use the same paired set as Figure 1 (b). Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图5:Jev的固定订单协议包括多次错误. 八项原订请求:(a) 平均准确性,(b) 所有八项协议,(c) 丧失初步成功率,(d) 在整个过程中回答错误的问题。 小组使用与图1(b)相同的组合。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。

blocks.en: Figure 6: High fixed-order agreement also repeats errors. Eight original-order requests, with metrics as in Figure 5 . Identity statistics use each model’s fixed selection set; correctness metrics use the full collection. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图6:高定购协议也重复错误. 8项原始订单请求,指标如图5所示。 身份统计使用每个模型的固定选择集;正确性衡量标准使用全部收集。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。

blocks.en: Jev reproductions make the distinction between repeatability and correctness particularly clear (Figure 6 ). They agree on 97.7–100% of their identity-set questions across eight requests, yet 52.2–78.0% receive the same wrong answer throughout. AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B and AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 repeat every observed choice; pplx-decider-v1.1-27b reaches 97.7%. Repeatedly selecting the argmax of native candidate probabilities can therefore produce highly stable errors.
blocks.zh: Jev复制对重复性和正确性的区分特别明确(图6 )。 他们同意在8项请求中提出97.7-100%的确定身份问题,然而52.2-78.0%在整个过程中得到同样的错误答复。 AutoTrust-JEV-Gemma4-26B-A4B和AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1重复每一个观察到的选择;pplx-decider-v1.1-27b达到97.7%. 因此,反复选择本地候选人概率的比值可以产生高度稳定的错误。

blocks.en: At an equal eight-call budget, Jev varies substantially more under reordering than under original-order repetition (Figure 7 ). On the question set shared by both conditions, its changed-choice rate is 23.6 percentage points higher for version 1.13 (95% interval 21.3–26.0) and 24.6 higher for version 1.14 (22.2–27.0), compared with differences of 2.2–7.2 across the six LLMs. This gap also extends to successful decisions. Jev loses 8.2–9.0% of its initial successes under repetition and 25.1–26.4% under reordering, with paired differences of 16.1 points (13.4–19.1) and 18.1 points (15.3–21.1), while mean accuracy differs by less than half a point. By contrast, GLM-5.3-Flash already loses 39.7% under original-order repetition, with a further 5.7-point difference under reordering. Variation under repetition and additional variation under reordering are distinct failure patterns.
blocks.zh: 在等同的八点会议预算中,Jev在重新排序时的差别远远大于原订重排时的差别(图7)。 关于两个条件共有的问题集,其变化选择率比1.13版(95%间隔21.3-26.0)高23.6个百分点,比1.14版(22.2-27.0)高24.6个百分点,而六个LLMs的差异为2.2-7.2个百分点。 这一差距还延伸到成功的决定。 Jev在重复下损失了8.2-9.0%的初始成功率,在重排下损失了25.1-26.4%,配对差异为16.1分(13.4–19.1)和18.1分(15.3–21.1),而平均准确度则差不到一半。 相比之下,GLM-5.3-Flash在原序重复下已经损失了39.7%,在重排下还有5.7点的差异. 重复变异和重排变异是明显的故障模式。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Reordering exposes more Jev instability at equal call counts. Eight original-order requests (hatched) versus eight reordered presentations (solid): (a) changed choices, (b) loss of initial successes, (c) mean accuracy, and (d) plurality gain over mean accuracy. Error bars show pointwise 95% paired bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图7 重排会让Jev在等价计时出现更多的不稳定. 8项原序请求(附图)相对于8项重序演示文稿(实图): (a) 改变选择, (b) 失去最初的成功, (c) 平均准确度, (d) 多元性超过平均准确度。 错误栏显示95%对齐的靴子间隔 。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Reordering reveals failures rarely seen under repetition. Eight calls per condition, with metrics as in Figure 7 . Identity sets are fixed jointly across conditions; correctness metrics use the full collection. Error bars show pointwise 95% paired bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图8:重排显示的失败很少重复。 每个情况8个电话,指标如图7所示。 身份套件是跨条件联合固定的;正确性衡量标准使用全部收集. 错误栏显示95%对齐的靴子间隔 。

blocks.en: The Jev reproductions make this distinction especially clear: they lose only 0–1.3% of initial successes under repetition, compared with 23.2–64.2% under reordering (Figure 8 ). Their changed-choice rates are 36.3–73.9 percentage points higher under reordering, versus differences of 25.8 and 25.9 for the Jev references. Identity rates here use each model’s fixed selection set across both conditions, as defined in Section 2.4 .
blocks.zh: Jev的复制特别明确地说明了这种区别:在重复的情况下,它们只损失了0-1.3%,而在重新排序的情况下,则损失了23.2-64.2 %(图8)。 其选择变更率在重新排序时高出36.3-73.9个百分点,而Jev参考文献的差异为25.8和25.9。 此处的识别率使用第2.4节界定的每个模型的固定选择。

blocks.en: Shorter sequences give the same qualitative result. Combining the original with each of the 21 pairs of non-original presentations yields a three-call comparison against three original-order requests. On a common question set, Jev’s excess changed-choice rate is 17.3–20.0 points for version 1.13 and 18.8–21.3 for version 1.14, versus 0.5–6.2 across the LLMs. Removing the shared original request also retains a 12.6–12.9-point excess for Jev. The large repetition–reordering gap is therefore not specific to using all eight presentations or including their shared initial response.
blocks.zh: 更短的序列给出了相同的定性结果. 将原稿与21对非原稿中的每对单稿合并后,会产生与3对原稿顺序请求的三合一比较. 关于一个共同的问题集,Jev的超额变更选择率为1.13版的17.3–20.0分,1.14版的18.8–21.3分,而全LLMs的0.5–6.2分. 删除共享的原始请求还保留了Jev的12.6至12.9分的超标。 因此,大的重复-重排顺序差距并不具体用于使用所有八种表述或包括它们共同的初步反应。

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next shows why the overall failure rate and the repetition–reordering gap answer different questions. Its changed-choice rate rises from 45.3% under repetition to 50.1% under reordering, an increase of 4.9 points compared with Jev’s 23.6–24.6. Its loss of initial successes rises by 3.7 points, from 29.2% to 32.9%. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next loses more successes than Jev under reordering, but much of its variability is already present with the menu fixed.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-Flash-Next显示整体故障率和重复-重排漏洞为何回答不同问题. 其改变的选择率从重复45.3%上升到重排50.1%,比Jev的23.6-24.6增加了4.9个百分点。 其初始成功率下降3.7个百分点,从29.2%上升到32.9%。 Qune3.8-Flash-Next在重排中比Jev损失更多的成功,但其许多可变性随着菜单的固定已经存在.

blocks.en: 3.5 Errors Extend Beyond a Single Distractor
blocks.zh: 3.5 超越单一灾难的错误

blocks.en: First-failure counts do not distinguish a persistent distractor from several distinct wrong answers on the same question. We therefore examine distinct question–wrong-option pairs, retaining selections after a question’s first error.
blocks.zh: 首先失败的计数并不能区分一个持续的分散注意力者与同一问题的若干明显错误的答案。 因此,我们审查不同的问题-错误的选项对,在问题的第一个错误发生后保留选择。

blocks.en: If every failed question had one fixed wrong answer, the pair count would grow only when another question failed. Jev 1.14 illustrates why this description is incomplete. Its original presentation produces 746 wrong pairs, one for each incorrectly answered question. After eight presentations, 965 questions have failed at least once, but the model has selected 1,449 distinct wrong pairs. The 703 additional pairs comprise 219 newly affected questions and 484 extra wrong candidates beyond the first per affected question. The latter component includes both initially failed questions and questions that first fail later and then receive another wrong answer.
blocks.zh: 如果每个失败的问题都有一个固定的错误答案,只有在另一个问题失败时,对数才会增长. Jev 1.14说明了这一描述为何不完整。 其原始演示文稿共产生746对错,每对答错的问题各一个. 经过8个演示,965个问题至少一次失败,但模型选择了1,449个明显的错对. 新增的703对包括219个新受影响的问题和484个在第一个受影响的问题之外的额外错误候选人。 后一部分既包括最初失败的问题,也包括后来先失败,然后又收到另一个错误答案的问题.

blocks.en: Equation 4 separates these two sources for every model (Figure 9 ). Extra wrong candidates account for 68.8–68.9% of Jev’s pair growth, similar to Qwen3.8-Flash-Next’s 68.0% and GLM-5.3-Flash’s 70.7%, and above the other four LLMs’ 50.2–58.5%. For example, GPT-6.1-sol’s increase from 437 to 661 pairs splits almost equally between 111 newly affected questions and 113 extra wrong candidates. Most of Jev’s, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next’s, and GLM-5.3-Flash’s pair growth thus reflects additional ways to fail on affected questions, rather than the first failures counted in Obs. 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 方程式4为每个型号分别了这两个来源(图9). 额外错误的考生占Jev成对增长的68.8-68.9%,类似于Qune3.8-Flash-Next的68.0%和GLM-5.3-Flash的70.7%,高于其他四个LLMs. 50.2–58.5% (中文(简体) ). 例如,GPT-6.1-sol从437对增加到661对,在111个新受影响的问题和113个额外错误的候选人之间几乎平分。 Jev的大部分,Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的,和GLM-5.3-Flash的配对增长,因此反映了在受影响的问题上失败的其他方式,而不是Obs中计算的第一个失败. 3.2 (英语).
