(a) Original errors U 1 U_{1} , (b) newly failed questions B 8 − B 1 B_{8}-B_{1} , (c) extra wrong candidates beyond the first per affected question D 8 D_{8} , and (d) their sum U 8 U_{8} . Counts are distinct question–wrong-option pairs and can exceed the number of questions. Every request retains the full menu.
blocks.zh: 图9:其他错误候选人导致Jev的大部分增长不合理。 (a) 原始错误 U 1 U_{1}, (b) 新失效的问题 B 8 − B 1 B_{8}- B_{1}, (c) 除了第一个问题 D 8 D_{8} 之外,还有额外的错误候选人, (d) 其总和 U 8 U_{8}。 数是不同的问题 - 错误的选项对, 并且可以超过问题的数量 。 每个请求保留完整的菜单.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Additional distractors dominate wrong-pair growth in Jev reproductions. (a) Original wrong pairs U 1 U_{1} , (b) newly observed questions with an actual wrong candidate W 8 − W 1 W_{8}-W_{1} , (c) extra wrong candidates D 8 D_{8} , and (d) all distinct wrong pairs U 8 U_{8} . Extra candidates account for 70.8–89.5% of growth.
blocks.zh: 图 10:额外的分心器在Jev复制中主导错误的pair生长. (a) 原错对U 1 U_{1},(b) 新观察到的与实际错误候选人W 8 - W 1 W_{8}-W_{1},(c) 额外错误候选人D 8 D_{8}和(d) 所有明显错误的对U 8 U_{8}。 额外候选人占增长的70.8-89.5%。

blocks.en: Extra wrong candidates account for 70.8–89.5% of wrong-pair growth in the twelve Jev reproductions, from AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 to StartLux-Decision-v1-0.8B (Figure 10 ). Nearly perfect fixed-order agreement can thus coexist with several distinct wrong answers to the same question under reordering.
blocks.zh: 额外错误候选人占12人中错误增长的70.8-89.5% Jev复制,从自动Trust-JEV-27B-v1.1到StartLux-Decision-v1-0.8B (图10). 因此,几乎完美的固定订单协议可以与重新排序中同一问题的若干明显错误的答案共存。

blocks.en: Jev’s distinct wrong-pair count increases by 87.8–94.2%, far more than its 27.3–29.4% increase in failed questions. This is not the largest relative pair growth: the LLM increases range from 51.3% for GPT-6.1-sol to 211.4% for GLM-5.3-Flash, with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next also exceeding Jev. The distinction is between spreading failure to more questions and exposing more ways to fail on a question.
blocks.zh: Jev的明显错误计算增加了87.8-94.2 %,远远超过其27.3-29.4 %的失败问题。 这不是最大的相对对增长:LLM的增速从GPT-6.1-sol的51.3%到GLM-5.3-Flash的211.4%不等,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017和Qune3.8-Flash-Next也超过了Jev. 区别在于将失败扩大到更多的问题和揭露在某个问题上失败的更多方式。

blocks.en: Multiple distractors are selected on 337–354 questions for Jev, below Qwen3.8-Flash-Next’s 404 and GLM-5.3-Flash’s 569, and above the 94–222 for the other four LLMs. Their contribution persists late in the sequence. Of Jev’s 41–46 new wrong pairs in the final presentation, 34–38 select a different wrong candidate on a previously affected question, accounting for 82.6–82.9% of the additions. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 show a similar pattern, with shares of 80.8% and 79.6%. Late error discovery therefore mainly broadens the observed ways to fail within affected questions, even as a smaller number of previously successful questions fail for the first time.
blocks.zh: 在Jev的337–354个问题上选择了多个分心器,下面是Qune3.8-Flash-Next的404和GLM-5.3-Flash的569,以上是另外四个LLMs的94–222. 它们的贡献一直持续到后来。 在最后的介绍中,Jev的41-46个新错对中,34-38个在以前受影响的问题上选择了不同的错对候选人,占增加数的82.6-82.9%. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017显示类似模式,份额分别为80.8%和79.6%. 因此,最近发现的误差主要扩大了所观察到的在受影响问题中失败的方法,即使以前成功的问题数目较少,也是第一次失败。

blocks.en: The expansion is not specific to choosing the original or final presentation as a reference. Relative to the mean wrong-pair count of a single presentation, the full union is 86.2–92.0% larger for Jev and 53.9–214.9% larger for the LLMs. Averaging over all eight ways to omit one presentation leaves 42.4–47.4 unseen pairs for Jev, versus 15.5–125.8 for the LLMs. These comparisons characterize the recorded responses without predicting saturation under further evaluation.
blocks.zh: 扩展并非专门选择原始或最后列报作为参考。 相对于平均错误的单一陈述计算,Jev的完整结合度为86.2-92.0%,LLMs为53.9-214.9%。 纵观所有八种方式省略一种演示文稿,Jev留下了42.4-47.4不可见的对,而LLMs则留下了15.5-15.8对。 这些比较是所记录的答复的特点,没有预测在进一步评价时的饱和程度。

blocks.en: The recorded errors therefore extend beyond one stable distractor per question. Because every request retains the full menu, these observations do not establish how the model would respond if a wrong candidate were removed.
blocks.zh: 因此,记录的错误超出了每个问题一个稳定的分心器。 由于每个请求都保留了完整的菜单,这些观察无法确定如果一个错误的候选人被移除,模型会如何回应.

blocks.en: 4 How Does Jev’s Order Robustness Vary Across Tasks?
blocks.zh: 4 Jev的强健性如何贯穿任务?

blocks.en: The pooled results establish that Jev’s stable score conceals lost successes. We now ask how broadly this pattern holds across benchmarks, difficulty levels, topics, and menu sizes. Each profile separates changed choices from lost initial successes, since a model can appear stable by remaining wrong. These subgroup comparisons locate vulnerability without isolating its causes.
blocks.zh: Jev的稳定得分掩盖了所失去的成功。 我们现在问,这种模式在基准、困难程度、议题和菜单大小之间具有多大的差别。 每个剖面图将选择与失去的初始成功区分开来,因为一个模型会因为保持错误而显得稳定. 这些分组比较找出脆弱性,而不孤立其根源。

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparisons Across Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 跨基准比较

blocks.en: The ordering of models by stability can change across benchmarks (Figure 11 ). On LEXam, Jev changes 39.9–42.9% of choices, below DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017’s 47.1%, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next’s 61.6%, and GLM-5.3-Flash’s 75.5%, but above GPT-6.1-sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 5.5. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 instead changes fewer choices than either Jev version on SuperGPQA. GPT-6.1-sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash remain more stable than Jev on both benchmarks, while Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash remain less stable. Jev’s relative position therefore depends on both the task and the comparator.
blocks.zh: 按稳定性排列的模型可以跨基准变化(图11)。 在LEXam上,Jev改变了39.9–42.9%的选择,低于DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017的47.1%,Quen3.8-Flash-Next的61.6%,以及GLM-5.3-Flash的75.5%,但高于GPT-6.1-sol,双子座3.8 Flash,以及克劳德·索内5.5. Depseek-V4.1-Flash-1017转而比超级GPQA上的Jev两个版本改变较少的选择. GPT-6.1-sol和双子座3.8 Flash在两个基准上都保持比Jev更稳定,而Qune3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash则保持稳定. 因此,Jev的相对地位取决于任务和参照国。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Jev’s relative stability depends on the task and baseline. By benchmark: (a) eight-presentation mean accuracy, (b) changed choices, (c) loss of initial successes, and (d) extra wrong pairs beyond the first per affected question, per 100 questions. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals (Section 2.6 ).
blocks.zh: 图11:Jev的相对稳定性取决于任务和基线. 按基准计算:(a) 8个表述的准确性;(b) 改变选择;(c) 失去初步成功;(d) 每100个问题中,每个问题中,超过第一个问题的额外错对。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔(第2.6节)。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Lower turnover need not mean better retention. Benchmark profiles of Jev reproductions, with metrics as in Figure 11 . AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 changes fewer choices than either Jev version on every benchmark, yet loses more initial successes than Jev 1.14 on LEXam. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图12:更替率较低并不一定意味着留用情况更好。 Jev复制的基准剖面图,如图11中的度量衡. AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 改变的选择比每个基准的Jev两个版本都要少,但比LEXam上的Jev 1.14 失去更多的初始成功. 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。

blocks.en: AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 changes fewer choices than either Jev version on each benchmark, but this does not translate into uniformly better retention (Figure 12 ). On LEXam, its loss of 20.5% lies between Jev 1.13’s 21.7% and Jev 1.14’s 17.9%, despite changing fewer choices than both. The distinction between preserving candidate identity and preserving correct answers therefore matters even within the decision-model group.
blocks.zh: AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 与每个基准上的Jev版本相比,改变选择较少,但这并没有转化为统一更好的保留(图12). 在LEXam上,其损失的20.5%发生在Jev 1.13的21.7%和Jev 1.14的17.9%之间,尽管改变的选择少于两者。 因此,保留候选人身份和保留正确答案之间的区别即使在决策模式组内也至关重要。

blocks.en: Lower turnover also need not yield more correct answers. Over half of Jev’s LEXam questions with changed choices remain wrong in every presentation. These always-wrong switches account for 21.7% of all paired LEXam questions for each Jev version, compared with 5.5–20.3% for the LLMs. Such trajectories contain no correct answer for voting to recover, linking the stability analysis to the aggregation results in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 降低更替率也无需产生更正确的答案。 超过一半的LEXAM问题, 这些总是错误的开关占每个Jev版本所有对齐的LEXam问题的21.7%,而LLMs则占5.5%-20.3%。 这种轨迹没有正确的恢复投票答案,将稳定性分析与第5节的汇总结果联系起来。

blocks.en: 4.2 Difficulty and the Persistence of Correct Answers
blocks.zh: 4.2 正确答案的难度和持久性

blocks.en: Hard questions challenge Jev beyond lowering its accuracy. Even conditional on an initially correct answer, 51.5–54.1% later become wrong, compared with 10.2–30.4% for five LLMs and 55.5% for GLM-5.3-Flash (Figure 13 ). An initial Jev success on these questions is therefore more often lost than preserved across all eight presentations. Jev’s overall changed-choice rate also rises from 27.2–30.2% on easy questions to 56.8–59.0% on hard questions. The five LLMs’ rates remain similar or decrease, whereas GLM-5.3-Flash rises from 47.7% to 65.3%. For Jev, the difficulty gradient concerns both the frequency of changing an answer and the fragility of an answer already known to be correct.
blocks.zh: 难题 Jev超越了降低准确度. 即使以最初正确答案为条件,51.5–54.1%后来也变成了错误,而5个有限责任公司为10.2–30.4%,GLM-5.3-Flash为55.5%。 因此,Jev在这些问题上取得的初步成功往往比所有八次发言都少。 Jev总的选择率变化也从简单问题的27.2-30.2%上升到硬问题的56.8-59.0%。 5个地方政府的利率依然相似或下降,而GLM-5.3-Flash从47.7%上升到65.3%。 就Jev而言,难度梯度既涉及改变答案的频率,也涉及已知正确答案的脆弱性。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Jev changes more choices on harder questions. SuperGPQA difficulty groups: (a) mean accuracy, (b) changed choices, (c) loss of initial successes, and (d) changed choices restricted to ten-option questions. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals. Panel (d) holds menu size fixed; question content still differs.
blocks.zh: 图13:Jev在更难的问题上改变更多的选择. 超级GPQA困难组:(a) 平均准确性,(b) 改变选择,(c) 丧失初步成功,(d) 改变选择仅限于十项选择问题。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。 (d) 保留固定菜单大小;问题内容仍然不同。

blocks.en: Figure 14: Hard questions expose greater order sensitivity in Jev reproductions. SuperGPQA profiles, as in Figure 13 . Every reproduction changes more choices on hard than easy questions, including within ten-option menus. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals; content and subject composition differ.
blocks.zh: 图14 困难问题暴露出Jev复制中更注重顺序敏感性. SuperGPQA简介,如图13. 每一次复制都会在困难问题上改变更多的选择,而不是容易的问题,包括在十项选择菜单中. 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔;内容和主题组成不同。

blocks.en: The difficulty gradient extends across the twelve Jev reproductions (Figure 14 ). Every model changes more choices on hard than easy SuperGPQA questions, including within ten-option menus. On hard questions overall, loss of initial successes ranges from 36.8% for AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 to 88.5% for StartLux-Decision-v1-4B. High fixed-order agreement thus does not protect a correct answer once the model confronts harder questions in a different order.
blocks.zh: 难度梯度跨越十二种Jev复制(图14.). 每个模型都会在硬度问题上比简单的SuperGPQA问题改变更多的选择,包括在十选项菜单内. 总的来说,在困难问题上,AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1的初始成功率从36.8%到StartLux-Decision-v1-4B的88.5%不等。 因此,当模型以不同顺序面对更困难的问题时,高定序协议并不能保护正确的答案.

blocks.en: Menu size does not fully explain this gradient. Within ten-option questions, Jev’s changed-choice rate rises from 27.0–29.0% on easy questions to 58.9–60.9% on hard questions; every LLM shows a smaller increase (Figure 13 (d)). Question content and subject composition still differ, so this comparison does not isolate difficulty itself.
blocks.zh: 菜单大小不能充分解释这个梯度. 在10个选项问题中,Jev的改变选择率从简单问题的27.0-29.0%上升到硬问题58.9-60.9%;每个LLM显示的增加幅度较小(图13(d))。 问题内容和主题构成仍然不同,因此这一比较并不孤立困难本身.

blocks.en: Correct-answer retention shows that the vulnerability is present even on easy questions (Figure 15 ). Within ten-option groups, Jev loses 14.9–18.8% of initial successes on easy questions, 26.0–26.1% on middle questions, and 48.6–48.7% on hard questions. Across all 731 ten-option questions, the loss is 25.2–27.4%, while each version’s accuracy varies by only 2.05 percentage points. Hard questions amplify the discrepancy between stable accuracy and fragile successes; they are not necessary for it to appear.
blocks.zh: 正确答案保留表明,即使在简单问题上也存在脆弱性(图15)。 在十个选项组中,Jev在简单问题上损失了14.9-18.8%的初始成功率,在中间问题上损失了26.0-26.1%,在硬问题上损失了48.6-48.7%。 在所有731个十选题中,损失率为25.2至27.4%,而每个版本的准确度只有2.05个百分点。 困难的问题加大了稳定准确度与脆弱成功之间的差别;这种差距是出现这种差距所不必要的。

blocks.en: Figure 15: Harder questions amplify Jev’s loss of correct answers. Retention across eight presentations for ten-option SuperGPQA questions: easy, middle, hard, and all difficulties. Each curve starts at 100% and retains a question only while every observed answer remains correct. Panels share a scale; question content differs across groups.
blocks.zh: 图15:更难的问题使Jev失去正确答案。 保留八个演示文稿,用于十选项SuperGPQA问题:简单,中间,硬,以及所有困难. 每个曲线从100%开始,只保留一个问题,而每个观察到的答案仍然正确。 面板共用一个比例;问题内容各组不同。

blocks.en: Figure 16: Correct choices by Jev reproductions are more fragile on hard questions. Ten-option SuperGPQA retention by difficulty. AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 loses 18.2% of initial successes on easy questions and 44.9% on hard questions. Panels share a scale, whose range differs from Figure 15 .
blocks.zh: 图16:Jev复制品的正确选择在难题上更加脆弱. 十选项 SuperGPQA 通过难度保留. 自动 Trust- JEV- 27B- v1.1 丢失 18.2%在简单问题方面取得初步成功,44.9%在困难问题方面取得初步成功。 小组共用一个比额表,其范围与图15不同。

blocks.en: The same ten-option analysis separates the Jev reproductions (Figure 16 ). AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 loses 18.2% of initial successes on easy questions and 44.9% on hard questions. The other eleven lose 66.2–93.3% on hard questions, compared with 50.0–53.4% for the Jev references in this comparison. A common candidate count therefore leaves substantial differences both across difficulty groups and within the Jev-style family.
blocks.zh: 同样的十选项分析将Jev复制品分离(图16). 自动 Trust- JEV- 27B- v1.1 丢失 18.2%在简单问题方面取得初步成功,44.9%在困难问题方面取得初步成功。 另外11个国家在硬质问题上损失了66.2%-93.3%,而Jev在这一比较中参考率为50.0-53.4。 因此,一个共同的候选人数在困难群体之间以及在Jev风格的家庭中都留下了巨大的差异。

blocks.en: Subject profiles help locate this difficulty gradient (Figure 17 ). Engineering and science contain much of Jev’s instability and many of the hard questions: 163 of 399 engineering questions and 142 of 321 science questions are hard, compared with nine of 93 in literature and arts. Their higher changed-choice rates are consistent with the difficulty result, without identifying an independent subject effect. Separating correctness changes from always-wrong switches also reveals which variation includes an answer that aggregation could recover.
blocks.zh: 主题剖析帮助定位此难度梯度(图17). 工程学和科学包含着Jev的许多不稳定性和许多难点:399个工程问题中有163个和321个科学问题中有142个是难点的,而文学和艺术93个问题中有9个是难点的. 其较高的变更选择率与难度结果一致,没有确定独立的主体效应. 从总是错误的开关中分离出正确性的变化还揭示出哪些变化包括一个可以恢复聚合的答案。

blocks.en: Figure 17: Subject profiles separate correctness changes from wrong-answer switches. By SuperGPQA discipline: (a) mean accuracy, (b) changed choices, (c) both correct and wrong answers, and (d) always wrong with changing candidates. Rates in (c,d) sum to (b). Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals. Other disciplines pools five groups with fewer than 30 questions each; subject and difficulty vary together.
blocks.zh: 图17:主题剖面将正确性变化与错误回答开关分开. 根据SuperGPQA学科:(a) 平均准确性,(b) 改变选择,(c) 正确和错误的答案,(d) 改变候选人总是不对。 (c、d)至(b)项的比率。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。 其他学科集合5组,每组题数不足30个;科目和难度各有不同.

blocks.en: Figure 18: Jev reproductions switch between wrong answers within subjects. SuperGPQA discipline profiles, using the decomposition in Figure 17 . Correctness changes and always-wrong switches partition each model’s changed-choice rate. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals; subject and difficulty vary together.
blocks.zh: 图18:Jev复制机在学科内部错误的答案之间切换. SuperGPQA学科简介,使用图17中的分解. 正确性会改变,并且总是错误的开关分区,每个模型的选择率都会改变。 错误栏显示为 95% 的靴子间隔; 对象和难度各有不同 。

blocks.en: Subject profiles also qualify the relatively favorable pooled result for AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 (Figure 18 ). It changes 43.9% of choices in engineering and 44.2% in science. Always-wrong switches account for 15.8% and 18.4% of all questions in those disciplines, respectively. Thus, its residual instability includes both lost or recovered correct answers and variation that never reaches the correct answer; the latter cannot be repaired by voting over the recorded choices.
blocks.zh: 主题简介还限定了AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1(图18)相对有利的集合结果。 它改变了43.9%的工程选择和44.2%的科学选择. 总是错误的开关分别占这些学科所有问题的15.8%和18.4%。 因此,其剩余不稳定性既包括丢失的或恢复的正确答案,也包括从未达到正确答案的变异;后者无法通过对记录的选择进行表决来弥补。

blocks.en: 4.3 Locating Instability Within Legal Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.3 在法律任务中分配不稳定性

blocks.en: LEXam reveals substantial heterogeneity across menu sizes. Larger-option groups combine lower accuracy with more changed choices for every model (Figure 19 ). Jev’s changed-choice rates rise from 22.4–23.3% in the four-option group to 66.9–74.6% in the 32-option group. Both Jev versions exceed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017’s 65.3% in the latter group, reversing their favorable comparison on LEXam overall. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash vary even more, changing 87.3% and 97.5% of choices. The same group yields 85.6–98.3 extra wrong pairs per 100 questions for Jev, compared with 162.7 for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and 230.5 for GLM-5.3-Flash. Larger menus thus identify a particularly unstable portion of this collection, with wrong-option diversity extending well beyond Jev. The groups contain different questions, however, and do not isolate the effect of adding distractors to a fixed question.
blocks.zh: LEXAM揭示了不同菜单大小的巨大异质性. 较大选项组结合了更低的精度和对每个模型的更多改变的选择(图19). Jev的改变选择率从四个选择组的22.4–23.3%上升到32个选择组的66.9–74.6%. Jev两个版本都超过了DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017的65.3%,扭转了它们与LEXam的有利比较。 Quen3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash的差别更大,改变了87.3%和97.5%。 同一组对Jev的每100个问题产生85.6-98.3个额外错误对数,而Qune3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash分别为162.7个和230.5个。 因此,更大的菜单可以识别出这个集合中特别不稳定的部分,错误的选项多样性远远超出Jev. 然而,这些小组包含不同的问题,并不孤立在固定问题中增加分散注意力者的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 19: Larger LEXam menus accompany more varied wrong choices. Option-count groups contain 125 questions each; metrics follow Figure 11 . Lines connect model estimates, with pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals. Groups contain different questions, so the comparison does not isolate an effect of option count.
blocks.zh: 图19 较大LEXAM菜单伴随更多样化的错误选择. 选项计数组各包含125个问题;衡量标准遵循图11。 线路连接模型估计值, 带有 95% 的靴子间隔 。 分组包含不同的问题,因此比较不会孤立选项计数的效果.

blocks.en: Figure 20: LEXam exposes both varied choices and menu limitations. Profiles include 4-, 8-, 16-, and 32-option questions, using the metrics in Figure 19 . Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals. Groups contain different questions.
blocks.zh: 图20: LEXAM既暴露了不同的选择,也暴露了菜单的限制. 简介包括4-、8-、16-和32-选项问题,采用图19中的衡量标准。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。 团体包含不同的问题。

blocks.en: Every reproduction changes more choices at 16 options than at eight, and more at eight than at four (Figure 20 ). AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 rises from 14.4% to 33.6% between four and 16 options, then reaches 55.2% at 32. Across four to 32 options, pplx-decider-v1.1-27b rises from 11.2% to 76.0%; AutoTrust-JEV-35B reaches 92.0% in the 32-option group. The remaining nine reproductions do not support 32-option menus, leaving their conditional stability metrics undefined.
blocks.zh: 每一次复制在16个选项上比8个选项改变更多的选择,在8个选项上比4个选项改变更多的选择(图20). 自动Trust-JEV-27B-v1.1在4至16个选项之间从14.4%上升到33.6%,然后在32个选项中达到55.2%. 在四种至32种选择中,pplx-decider-v1.1-27b从11.2%上升到76.0%;AutoTrust-JEV-35B在32种选择组中达到92.0%. 其余的9个复制不支持32选项菜单,使得其有条件的稳定性度量表没有定义.

blocks.en: 4.4 Option Count and Continued Failure Discovery
blocks.zh: 4.4 选项数和持续失败发现

blocks.en: Jev’s loss of initial successes persists on both sides of an eight-option threshold (Figure 21 ). Across the eight presentations, Jev loses 21.7–23.6% of its initially correct answers on questions with fewer than eight options and 26.9–28.0% on questions with at least eight. The comparison with LLMs also varies across these groups. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 loses 23.9% and 22.4%, respectively: slightly more than either Jev version in the smaller-menu group, but less than both in the larger-menu group. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next loses 35.8% and 33.2%, exceeding both Jev versions in each group. These differences qualify pooled comparisons without isolating an effect of menu size.
blocks.zh: Jev在八项选择的门槛值(图21)的两边都继续失去最初的成功。 Jev在8个演讲中,在最初正确回答的问题中损失了21.7–23.6%,在回答问题时损失了不到8个选项,在回答问题时损失了26.9–28.0%。 与法学硕士的比较也因这些群体而异。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017分别损失23.9%和22.4%:略高于小菜单组中的Jev版本,但小于大菜单组中的Jev版本. Qune3.8-Flash-Next损失35.8%和33.2%,超过每组Jev两个版本. 这些差异在不孤立菜单大小效果的情况下对集合比较进行限定。

blocks.en: Figure 21: Jev loses initial successes in both option-count groups. Retention through each presentation for (a) 437 questions with fewer than eight options and (b) 1,263 with at least eight. Each curve is normalized by the model’s initially correct answers in its group.
blocks.zh: 图21:Jev在两个选项计数组中都失去了初步成功。 每次陈述中保留(a) 437个问题,但少于8个选项;(b) 1 263个问题,其中至少有8个选项。 每个曲线都因模型在组中最初正确的答案而正常化.

blocks.en: Figure 22: Jev reproductions lose correct choices even with at least eight options. Groups and metric follow Figure 21 .
blocks.zh: 图22:Jev复制即使至少有8个选项,也会失去正确的选择. 图21。

blocks.en: Jev reproductions also lose initial successes in both groups (Figure 22 ). Losses range from 17.8–51.9% below eight options and 25.3–71.6% at eight or more. AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 has lower loss than either Jev version in both groups. The other eleven reproductions lose a larger fraction of their initial successes than either Jev version in the larger-menu group, showing that the vulnerability extends across the evaluated implementations.
blocks.zh: Jev复制在这两个组中也都失去了初步的成功(图22)。 损失范围从8种选择以下的17.8-51.9%和8种或8种以上25.3-71.6 %不等。 AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1在两组中的损失均低于Jev版本. 其他11种复制品在最初的成功中比大菜单组中的Jev版本损失了更大的部分,表明脆弱性遍及评价的执行。

blocks.en: The full option-count profile qualifies the LEXam trend (Figure 23 ). Jev’s changed-choice rate and loss of initial successes fluctuate across the four- to ten-option groups rather than increasing steadily with menu size. Composition matters: all ten-option questions are from SuperGPQA, while all 16- and 32-option questions are from LEXam. The profile identifies vulnerable groups without estimating what would happen if distractors were added to the same question.
blocks.zh: 完整的选项计数概况符合LEXam趋势(图23)。 Jev选择率的改变和最初成功率的丧失在四个至十个选择组之间波动,而不是随菜单大小而稳步增加。 组成事项:所有十选题来自SuperGPQA,而所有十六选题和三十二选题来自LEXam. 该简介查明了弱势群体,但没有估计如果将分散注意力者添加到同一问题中将会发生什么。

blocks.en: Figure 23: Jev’s instability has no uniform trend across menu sizes. All observed option counts: (a) mean accuracy, (b) changed choices, (c) loss conditional on initial success, and (d) newly failed questions after O per 100 questions, counted once. Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals. Benchmark and difficulty composition differ across groups.
blocks.zh: 图23:Jev的不稳定性在菜单尺寸方面没有统一的趋势。 所有观察到的选项都计算如下:(a) 平均准确性,(b) 改变选择,(c) 以初步成功为条件的损失,(d) 每100个问题中O后的新问题,计算一次。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。 基准和难度构成各组不同。

blocks.en: Figure 24: Jev reproductions fail across the full range of menu sizes. Four to 32 options; metrics follow Figure 23 . Error bars show pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals. Benchmark and question content differ across groups.
blocks.zh: 图24:Jev复制在菜单大小全程中失败. 4至32个选项;衡量标准遵循图23。 错误栏显示95%的靴子间隔 。 基准和问题内容各组不同。

blocks.en: The pooled profile of Jev reproductions similarly prevents a simple ranking by menu size (Figure 24 ). AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 loses 25.6% of initial successes on ten-option questions and 22.6% on 16-option questions, although its LEXam-only turnover increases across menu sizes. These groups differ in both benchmark and question content.
blocks.zh: Jev复制的集合剖面类似地阻止了按菜单大小进行简单的排序(图24 ). AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1在十个选项问题上损失了25.6%的初始成功率,在16个选项问题上损失了22.6%,尽管其LEXam独占的周转量在菜单大小上都有增加. 这些类别在基准和问题内容上都有所不同。

blocks.en: Small menus do not make repeated reordering uninformative. A four-option question has 4 ! = 24 4!=24 full permutations, so eight presentations need not repeat the same menu order. In the four-option group, 199 of 203 questions have eight distinct observed orders and the other four have seven. Jev 1.13’s cumulative failed-question count rises from 76 to 95, and Jev 1.14’s from 73 to 92. Presentations five through eight still expose four and two first failures, respectively. Counting only the first occurrence of each full permutation leaves both Jev failure trajectories unchanged. These distinct full orders need not place the correct answer in distinct positions. The curves measure robustness across the sampled menu orders, without assuming a new correct-answer position on every presentation.
blocks.zh: 小菜单不会使重复的重排不具有信息化性. 一个四选项问题有 4 ! = 24 4! = 24 完全轮廓,因此八个演示文稿不需要重复相同的菜单顺序. 在四选组中,203个问题中有199个有8个不同的观察命令,另外4个有7个. Jev 1.13的累计失利问题计数从76起增至95起,Jev 1.14的累计失利问题计数从73起增至92起. 专题介绍5至8仍然分别暴露了4次和2次首次失败。 仅仅计算每次完全演化的首次出现,就使得Jev两种故障轨迹都保持不变. 这些明确的完整命令不需要将正确答案置于不同的位置。 曲线测量了整个抽样菜单订单的稳健性,而没有假设每个演示文稿都有一个新的正确答案.

blocks.en: The number of new failures must also be read alongside the pool of initial successes. On 32-option questions, Jev loses 43.5–70.0% of initial successes, but this amounts to only 8.5–11.9 newly failed questions per 100. The ten-option rates are 25.2–27.4% and 14.5–15.9 per 100. Low initial accuracy leaves fewer successes available to fail, so a smaller cumulative increase can accompany greater conditional fragility. Both measures are needed to avoid mistaking a small remaining pool of correct answers for robustness.
blocks.zh: 新的失败次数也必须与最初的成功事例一并阅读。 关于32选项问题,Jev损失了43.5-70.0%的初始成功率,但这只相当于每100个新失败的问题8.5-11.9。 10个选择率是25.2-27.4%和14.5-15.9‰。 初始精度低,导致可用成功率下降,因此,累积增加幅度较小,可伴随条件更脆弱。 需要采取这两项措施,以避免误用剩余的一小批正确答案来保证其稳健性。

blocks.en: 5 Can Aggregating Reordered Choices Correct Jev’s Errors?
blocks.zh: 5 重新排列的选择能否纠正Jev的错误?

blocks.en: The same repeated answers that expose failures might also help correct them. Plurality voting could recover a correct answer that appears across several orders, while unanimity could identify a more reliable subset. We test both possibilities, asking whether variation supplies useful correction and whether agreement warrants confidence (Figure 25 ).
blocks.zh: 揭露失败的同样重复的答案也可能有助于纠正失败。 多次表决可以收回在若干顺序中出现的正确答案,而一致意见可以确定一个更可靠的子集。 我们检验两种可能性,询问变异是否提供有益的纠正,协议是否值得信任(图25)。

blocks.en: Figure 25: Voting offers limited Jev correction; unanimity still includes errors. Across eight orders: (a) mean accuracy, (b) plurality gain in percentage points, (c) unanimous coverage, and (d) accuracy among unanimous answers. Error bars show pointwise 95% paired source-group bootstrap intervals, stratified by benchmark. Plurality ties use uniform tie-breaking in expectation.
blocks.zh: 图25:投票提供了有限的Jev更正;一致意见仍然包括错误。 在八项命令中:(a) 平均准确性,(b) 百分率增加,(c) 一致覆盖,(d) 一致答复的准确性。 错误栏显示95%对齐的源组拖曳间隔, 按基准分级 。 多元关系在期望中采用统一的解绑.

blocks.en: Figure 26: Voting and unanimity provide limited safeguards for Jev reproductions. Metrics follow Figure 25 , with accuracy and coverage over all 1,700 questions. Unanimous accuracy ranges from 30.2% to 66.3% at differing coverage. Error bars show pointwise 95% paired bootstrap intervals; plurality ties use uniform tie-breaking in expectation.
blocks.zh: 图26:表决和一致为Jev复制提供了有限的保障。 量子跟随图25,准确度和覆盖所有1700个问题. 统一准确度在30.2%至66.3%之间,覆盖范围不同。 错误栏显示为 95% 配对的靴子间隔; 多元关系在预期中使用统一的解领带 。

blocks.en: 5.1 Voting Recovers Only Part of the Error
blocks.zh: 5.1 只收回部分错误

blocks.en: Combining eight reordered answers gives Jev only a modest accuracy gain: 0.81 percentage points for version 1.13 (95% interval 0.17–1.46) and 0.93 for version 1.14 (0.27–1.60). The reference is mean single-presentation accuracy, avoiding dependence on an unusually weak original round. LLM gains range from 0.42 points for GPT-6.1-sol to 5.03 for GLM-5.3-Flash, with positive lower bounds for all six intervals. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash gain 3.23 points (2.43–4.05) and 5.03 (4.04–6.00), respectively. Their lower pooled retention thus coexists with more effective correction through voting.
blocks.zh: 合并八个重排的答案 Jev只获得微小的精度增益:1.13版0.81个百分点(95%间隔0.17–1.46),1.14版0.93个百分点(0.27–1.60. 引用是指单呈现精度,避免依赖异常弱的原始回合. LLM增益从GPT-6.1-索尔的0.42分到GLM-5.3-Flash的5.03分不等,所有6个间隔都有正下限. Wen3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash分别获得3.23分(2.43–4.05)和5.03分(4.04–6.00). 因此,通过表决更有效地纠正这些保留人数较少的现象,就同时存在。

blocks.en: The trajectories help explain why correction is limited. Jev 1.14 gains only 0.27 points on LEXam ( − 0.75 -0.75 –1.28), where many changed choices remain wrong throughout. Such trajectories supply no correct vote; even when the correct answer appears, it must receive enough votes to defeat the alternatives. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash gain 2.90 points (1.19–4.42) and 4.19 (2.35–6.04) on LEXam, while the GPT-6.1-sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash intervals span zero. The usefulness of variation depends on which candidates are selected and how often, rather than on the amount of disagreement alone.
blocks.zh: 轨迹有助于解释修正受到限制的原因。 Jev 1.14在LEXAM上只获得0.27分(−0.75-0.75–1.28),其中许多改变的选择在整个过程中仍然是错误的. 这种轨迹不能提供正确的投票;即使出现正确的答案,它也必须获得足够的投票,以挫败其他选择。 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash在LEXam上获得2.90分(1.19-4.42)和4.19分(2.35-6.04),而GPT-6.1-sol和双子座3.8闪电间隔跨度为零. 变化的有用性取决于选择哪些候选人以及选择多少候选人,而不是仅仅取决于分歧的程度。

blocks.en: The eight-call comparison further limits the practical benefit of Jev’s variation. Voting gain, measured relative to each condition’s mean single-request accuracy, is only 0.75 points higher under reordering for Jev 1.13 (95% interval 0.06–1.49) and 0.96 higher for Jev 1.14 (0.24–1.71), alongside a roughly 24-point difference in changed-choice rates. The direct differences in plurality accuracy between conditions have intervals spanning zero for both versions. Thus, the greater variation under reordering accompanies a small additional voting gain relative to a single answer, without establishing higher final voting accuracy than original-order repetition.
blocks.zh: 八声比较进一步限制了Jev变化的实际好处. 与每个条件的平均单一要求精确度相比,投票收益在Jev 1.13(95%间隔0.06-1.49)的重排中仅高0.75分,Jev 1.14(0.24-1.71)的重排中则高0.96分,另加变化选择率的24点差异。 两个版本的条件在多元性准确度方面的直接差别,其间隔为零。 因此,在重新安排顺序时,变化较大,相对于单一答案而言,增加的表决增加幅度较小,而没有确定比原顺序重复更高的最终表决准确性。

blocks.en: Voting gains for Jev reproductions are also modest despite substantial turnover (Figure 26 ). They range from 0.74 points for AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 (95% interval 0.18–1.31) to 2.49 for StartLux-Decision-v1-35B-A3B (1.71–3.32), with positive lower bounds for all twelve models. Reordering provides some recoverable correct choices, but the gains remain small relative to the widespread changes it exposes.
blocks.zh: 尽管更换很多,但Jev复制的投票收益也不大(图26)。 它们从自动Trust-JEV-27B-v1.1的0.74分(95%间隔0.18–1.31)到StartLux-Decision-v1-35B-A3B(1.71–3.32)的2.49分不等,所有12种模型的正下限. 重新排序提供了一些可收回的正确选择,但相对于它所暴露的广泛变化而言,收益仍然很小。

blocks.en: 5.2 Agreement and Persistent Error
blocks.zh: 5.2 协议和持续错误

blocks.en: Unanimity raises Jev’s conditional accuracy but leaves substantial error among the retained answers. The two versions select the same candidate in all eight presentations on 59.9–61.0% of questions, with accuracy of 63.2–63.9% on this subset. Thus, 36–37% of unanimous answers are wrong. These persistent mistakes account for 21.6–22.4% of all paired questions, each receiving the same wrong Jev answer eight times. They survive even the strongest agreement requirement available in the recorded trajectories. Such mistakes are not, by themselves, evidence of order bias; they show why surviving the reordering test is insufficient to certify a correct decision.
blocks.zh: 团结提高 Jev的有条件准确性,但在保留的答复中留下了很大的错误。 这两个版本在59.9-61.0%的问题的所有8个介绍中都选择了同样的候选人,在这个子集中的准确度为63.2-63.9%. 因此,36-37%的一致答复是错误的。 这些持续的错误占所有对齐问题中的21.6–22.4%,每个问题都收到同样的Jev错误回答8次. 它们在记录的轨迹中甚至能维持最有力的一致要求。 这种错误本身并不是秩序偏向的证据;它们表明为什么在重新秩序测试中幸存下来不足以证明正确的决定。

blocks.en: The same unanimity rule retains more accurate answers for each LLM, although at different coverage. The retained LLM answers are 17.6–21.4% wrong, compared with Jev’s 36–37%. GPT-6.1-sol has the broadest coverage at 82.6%, with 78.6% conditional accuracy, while DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Gemini 3.8 Flash retain 65.5–79.0% of questions at 79.5–81.1% accuracy. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash retain fewer questions than Jev, at 49.2% and 37.3% coverage, but reach 81.8% and 82.4% accuracy. Agreement improves conditional accuracy within each model, yet the surviving Jev decisions remain substantially less reliable at these observed operating points. Differences in base accuracy and coverage prevent this comparison from isolating the predictive value of agreement or establishing a ranking at matched coverage.
blocks.zh: 同样的一致规则为每个LLM保留了更准确的答案,尽管覆盖范围不同. 与Jev的36-37%相比,所保留的LLM回答错误为17.6–21.4%. GPT-6.1-索尔的覆盖范围最广,为82.6%,有条件的准确度为78.6%,而DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,Claude Sonnet 5.5,和双子座3.8 Flash则保留了65.5–79.0%的问题,精确度为79.5–81.1%. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next和GLM-5.3-Flash保留的问题比Jev少,覆盖率为49.2%和37.3%,但准确率达到81.8%和82.4%。 协议提高了每个模型的有条件准确性,然而,在这些观察到的操作点,幸存的Jev决定的可靠性要低得多。 基准准确度和覆盖范围的差异使这种比较无法孤立协议的预测值或确定相应覆盖范围的排名。

blocks.en: The Jev reproductions reinforce this limitation of unanimity. Their unanimous subsets reach only 30.2–66.3% accuracy, with coverage ranging from 24.1% to 63.7% of the full collection. AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 has the highest coverage, yet 42.4% of its unanimous answers are wrong; these persistent errors account for 27.0% of all 1,700 questions. Across the twelve models, 12.1–27.0% of questions receive the same wrong answer in every presentation. High agreement under fixed-order repetition therefore cannot certify correctness either before or after reordering.
blocks.zh: 捷夫复制案强化了这种一致性限制。 它们的一致子集只有30.2至66.3%的准确度,覆盖范围为全集的24.1%至63.7%。 AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1的覆盖率最高,然而其42.4%的一致回答是错误的;这些持续的错误占所有1700个问题的27.0%. 在12种模式中,12.1-27.0%的问题在每次介绍中得到同样的错误答案。 因此,在固定订单重复下达成的高水平协议无法证明在重新订单之前或之后是否正确。

blocks.en: 6 Does Higher Accuracy Protect Correct Choices?
blocks.zh: 6 更高的准确性是否保护正确的选择?

blocks.en: Does higher accuracy protect Jev’s successful decisions? MMLU-Pro provides a setting where Jev answers most questions correctly, allowing us to examine whether those successes also survive reordering. Accuracy uses all 300 questions. The other panels use each model’s fixed set of questions with selections in all fifteen distinct requests. These sets can differ across models, so the trajectories support within-model comparisons rather than rankings on identical questions.
blocks.zh: 是否保护更高的准确性 Jev的成功决定? MMLU-Pro提供了一个环境,让Jev正确回答大多数问题,让我们审查这些成功是否也能够幸存下来。 准确度使用所有300个问题. 其他小组在所有15项不同的请求中都使用每个模型的固定问题集,并有选择。 这些集可以因模型的不同而不同,因此轨迹支持模型内部的比较,而不是对相同问题的排名.

blocks.en: Figure 27: Jev’s higher MMLU-Pro accuracy still leaves correct answers vulnerable. (a) Accuracy on all 300 questions; (b) cumulative failed questions; (c) loss of initial successes after eight original-order or reordered requests; (d) coverage and accuracy of answers unanimous across reordered presentations. Panels (b–d) use each model’s fixed selection set defined in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 图27:Jev较高的MMLU-Pro精度仍然使正确答案脆弱。 (a) 所有300个问题的准确性;(b) 累计失效的问题;(c) 在8项原订或重订请求之后,丧失了初步的成功率;(d) 重订的报表中一致答复的范围和准确性。 专门小组(b-d)使用第6节界定的每个模型的固定选择。

blocks.en: Figure 28: Perfect repetition does not protect Jev reproductions from reordering. MMLU-Pro results for twelve Jev reproductions with both Jev versions as references, using the panels in Figure 27 . All panels use the complete 300-question sample.
blocks.zh: 图28 完美重复并不能保护Jev复制品的重排. 使用图27中的面板复制了12份Jev版本作为参考的MMLU-Pro结果。 所有面板都使用完整的300个问题样本.

blocks.en: Jev 1.13 and Jev 1.14 average 86.4% and 86.0% accuracy over the reordered presentations, with ranges of 3.7 and 3.3 percentage points (Figure 27 (a)). Yet their cumulative failure sets grow from 35 to 58 and from 36 to 63 questions, respectively. The additional 23 and 27 failures represent 8.7% and 10.2% of initially correct answers, compared with losses of only 1.1% and 2.7% under original-order repetition. Each version first fails on two more questions in the final presentation. The loss is smaller than on the primary collection, but it persists even when Jev answers most questions correctly.
blocks.zh: Jev 1.13和Jev 1.14 重排演示文稿的平均精度为86.4%和86.0%,幅度为3.7和3.3个百分点(图27(a))。 然而,它们的累积失败率分别从35个增加到58个,从36个增加到63个。 另外23和27次失败占最初正确答案的8.7%和10.2%,而在原订单重复情况下损失仅为1.1%和2.7%。 每个版本在最后介绍中首先在另外两个问题上失败. 损失比主集小,但即使在Jev最正确回答大多数问题时,损失仍然持续.

blocks.en: All twelve Jev reproductions repeat exactly the same candidate across eight original-order requests, yet lose 8.6–45.0% of initial successes under reordering (Figure 28 ). Thus, the separation between repeatability and preservation of correct choices persists on a different benchmark. As in the primary collection, the comparison describes the evaluated systems without isolating an architectural cause.
blocks.zh: 所有十二次Jev复制在八次原订申请中都重复了完全相同的候选人,但在重新订货过程中却损失了8.6–45.0%的初始成功率(图28)。 因此,在不同的基准上,重复性和保留正确选择之间的区别依然存在。 与主集一样,比较描述了所评价的系统,而不孤立建筑事业。

blocks.en: Jev’s unanimous answers are more accurate here than on the primary collection, but agreement still does not certify correctness. They cover 88.3% and 86.0% of questions and reach 91.3% and 91.9% accuracy (Figure 27 (d)); 8.7% and 8.1% of the retained answers are still wrong. Thus, both the loss under reordering and the reliability of agreement depend on the task collection. What transfers is the distinction among average accuracy, fixed-order repeatability, and the survival of individual correct decisions.
blocks.zh: Jev的一致回答比主集更准确, 它们涵盖88.3%和86.0%的问题,准确度达到91.3%和91.9%(图27(d));8.7%和8.1%的保留答复仍然是错误的。 因此,重新排序下的损失和协议的可靠性都取决于任务收集情况。 转移是平均准确性、固定顺序重复性和个别正确决定的存续之间的区别。

blocks.en: 7 Does a Four-Option Menu Remove the Vulnerability?
blocks.zh: 7 四可选菜单是否消除脆弱性?

blocks.en: Four candidates still allow many rearrangements, so a short menu need not make repeated reordering uninformative. GPQA Diamond tests whether Jev’s loss of initial successes persists when every question has only four options. Figures 29 and 30 use all 198 questions and the common eight-presentation protocol.
blocks.zh: 四名候选人仍然允许许多重排,因此一个短菜单不需要使反复重排的不建议. GPQA 地图 当每个问题只有四个选择时, 图29和图30使用了所有198个问题和通用的八项介绍协议。

blocks.en: Figure 29: Four candidates still leave correct Jev choices vulnerable. GPQA Diamond: (a) accuracy, (b) cumulative failed questions, (c) initial-success loss under repetition and reordering, and (d) distinct wrong question–candidate pairs. All panels use the full 198 questions.
blocks.zh: 图29:有4名候选人仍然任由乔夫作出正确的选择。 GPQA Diamond:(a) 准确性,(b) 累计失败的问题,(c) 在重复和重排时的初始成功损失,以及(d) 明显错误的问题-可选对。 所有小组都使用全部198个问题.

blocks.en: Figure 30: Perfect repetition coexists with lost successes on four-option questions. GPQA Diamond results for Jev reproductions, with both Jev versions as references. Panels and denominators follow Figure 29 .
blocks.zh: 图30:完美重复与在四个选项问题上失去的成功共存。 GPQA Diamond为Jev复制的结果,两个Jev版本都作为参考. 小组和分母遵循图29。

blocks.en: Jev 1.13 and Jev 1.14 average 76.6% and 72.6% accuracy, yet their cumulative failure sets grow from 52 to 76 and from 58 to 89 questions. Reordering loses 16.4% and 22.1% of their initial successes, compared with 4.1% and 7.1% under original-order repetition. All twelve Jev reproductions repeat their original choices perfectly but lose 23.7–66.7% of initial successes after reordering. The gap between repeatability and preservation of successful decisions therefore extends to four-option questions. It does not require the larger menus in the primary collection.
blocks.zh: Jev 1.13和Jev 1.14的平均精度为76.6%和72.6%,但其累计故障集从52个增加到76个,从58个增加到89个问题。 重排损失了16.4%和22.1%的初始成功率,而原订单重排损失了4.1%和7.1%。 所有十二次Jev复制都完美地重复了原来的选择,但在重新订购后损失了23.7–66.7%的初始成功率. 因此,胜诉决定的重复性和保留之间的差距扩大到四个备选问题。 它不需要主收藏中更大的菜单.

blocks.en: The observed loss of initial successes varies across the LLMs, from 3.3% for GPT-6.1-sol to 21.7% for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and 44.9% for GLM-5.3-Flash. These results do not establish a uniform family ranking. Repeated errors also need not select the same distractor. Jev accumulates 95 and 112 distinct wrong question–candidate pairs across its 76 and 89 failed questions. The reproductions accumulate 142–281 such pairs. Excluding the two questions with duplicate distractor text preserves the Jev repetition–reordering gap. Short menus therefore remain informative about the survival of correct choices, although comparisons across benchmarks do not isolate candidate count from content or difficulty.
blocks.zh: 观测到的初始成功率在各种LLMs中各不相同,GPT-6.1-Sol为3.3%,Qune3.8-Flash-Next为21.7%,GLM-5.3-Flash为44.9%。 这些结果并没有确立统一的家族排名. 重复错误也无需选择相同的转移器. Jev累积了95和112个明显错误的问题, 复制品积累了142–281对这种配对. 排除两个带有重复分心文字的问题,保留了Jev重复-重排顺序的空白. 因此,简短的菜单仍然能说明正确选择是否继续存在,尽管对基准的比较并不能将候选人的计数与内容或困难分开。

blocks.en: 8 Implications and Scope
blocks.zh: 8 影响和范围

blocks.en: Our results provide no evidence of a general Jev advantage in preserving correct choices across option orders. Four LLMs retain more shared initial successes (Obs. 3.3 ), but Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, GLM-5.3-Flash, and the task-dependent comparisons rule out a universal ranking. The contribution beyond pairwise order-sensitivity studies ( Lukassen et al., 2026 ) is to trace the cumulative consequences: which initial successes are lost, how widely failures spread, and whether further orders still reveal first failures. The magnitude and timing of that loss carry the evidence; monotonic growth of a cumulative set does not.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果不能证明Jev在维护选择权命令的正确选择方面具有普遍优势。 四个LLMs保留了更多共享的初始成功(Obs. 3.3),但Qune3.8-Flash-Next,GLM-5.3-Flash,任务依赖的比较排除了普遍排名. 双向秩序敏感性研究(Lukassen等人,2026年)之外的贡献是追踪累积后果:哪些初始成功被丢失,失败的传播程度如何,进一步的命令是否仍然揭示了最初的失败. 这一损失的规模和时间都附有证据;一个累积装置的单体增长不是。

blocks.en: The Jev reproductions show that a shared decision interface can coexist with substantially different robustness. On the primary collection, AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1 retains more initial successes than the Jev references, whereas the other eleven reproductions retain fewer. Their near-perfect fixed-order agreement does not predict this ordering. Explaining the differences requires isolating the choices in representation, learning, and computation that the shared interface leaves unspecified.
blocks.zh: Jev的复制表明,共享的决定界面可以与显著不同的强性共存. 在主集上,AutoTrust-JEV-27B-v1.1保留了比Jev参考文献更多的初始成功,而其他11个复制作品保留较少. 他们近乎完美的固定订单协议无法预测这种订单. 解释这些差异需要隔离表达、学习和计算方面的选择,即共享界面留下未加说明。

blocks.en: A useful diagnostic need not be an effective correction. Reordering exposes lost successes and multiple wrong candidates, but voting yields only a small accuracy gain for Jev. Always-wrong trajectories contain no correct vote, and unanimous errors pass an agreement filter unchanged (Obs. 5.2 ). These persistent errors do not themselves demonstrate order bias; they limit agreement as a safeguard. Nor does observing several wrong candidates establish what would happen after one is removed. An adaptive masking study could compare removing the previously selected wrong candidate with removing a random distractor at matched menu sizes, separating targeted correction from the benefit of fewer choices.
blocks.zh: 一个有用的诊断不需要是有效的纠正。 重新排序会暴露失败和多个错误候选人,但投票结果对Jev来说只有微小的准确性增益。 总是错误的轨迹没有包含正确的投票,一致错误通过协议过滤器,没有改变(Obs.5.2 ) 。 这些持续存在的错误本身并不表明有秩序偏向;它们限制协议作为保障。 观察几个错误的候选人也没有确定一个候选人被除名后会发生什么。 一项适应性的遮盖研究可以将删除之前选错的候选者与在匹配的菜单大小上删除随机分流器进行比较,将有针对性的校正与较少选择的好处区分开来.

blocks.en: Original-order repetition characterizes variation without changing the menu. Its comparison with reordering describes behavioral differences without isolating a causal order effect. Candidate identifiers travel with their content while entry order changes, leaving the source of presentation sensitivity unresolved. Prior work distinguishes identifier preferences from position and context effects ( Azizi et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) ; our experiment neither separates these components nor establishes how a proprietary interface represents them.
blocks.zh: 原序重复描述变异性而不改变菜单. 它与重排的比较描述了行为差异而不孤立因果顺序效应. 候选标识符在输入顺序改变时随其内容一同旅行,使演示文稿敏感度的来源得不到解决. 先前的工作将标识偏好与位置和上下文效果区分开来(Azizi等人,2026年;Zheng等人,2024年) ;我们的实验既没有将这些组件区分开来,也没有确定专有界面如何代表它们.

blocks.en: Training, inference, and interface also differ across models, precluding a causal claim about decision heads or generation. The literature offers starting points for controlled comparisons: frozen LLM readouts keep the backbone fixed ( Li and Wagle, 2026 ) , and serialization interventions keep weights fixed ( Azizi et al., 2026 ) . Further comparisons could vary decision-specific adaptation or candidate interaction separately. The supporting survey organizes these distinctions alongside supervision, gradient paths, and execution. The present findings concern observed selections, not a recovered account of Jev’s proprietary mechanism.
blocks.zh: 培训、推论和界面也因不同模式而异,排除了对决策负责人或生成人的因果关系。 文献为可控比较提供了起点:冷冻LLM读取保持主干线固定(Li and Wagle, 2026),序列化干预保持权重固定(Azizi等人, 2026). 进一步的比较可能使具体决策的适应或候选互动有所不同。 辅助调查将这些区别与监督、梯度路径和执行安排在一起。 目前的调查结果涉及选择,而不是Jev专有机制的收回账户。

blocks.en: The results cover fixed task collections and eight presentations. Domain, language, difficulty, and candidate count vary together, while subgroup intervals are exploratory and do not adjust for multiple comparisons. MMLU-Pro and GPQA Diamond broaden the evidence, but differences in loss magnitude show its dependence on the collection. Continued first failures establish persistence within the observed sequence without predicting growth under further requests.
blocks.zh: 结果包括固定任务收集和八次介绍。 域,语言,难度,以及候选人计数各有不同,而分组间隔是探索性的,不为多重比较进行调整. MMLU-Pro和GPQA Diamond拓宽了证据,但损失程度的差异表明其对收集的依赖. 连续的初次失败在观测到的序列中确定持久性,而不在进一步的要求下预测增长。

blocks.en: 9 Related Work
blocks.zh: 9 相关工作

blocks.en: Early work on contextual calibration shows that language models carry answer preferences that can destabilize few-shot predictions as prompts and demonstrations change ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) . Option reordering provides a more direct test when question and answer content are held fixed ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ) . Position and identifier effects must nevertheless be distinguished. Zheng et al. (2024) identify preferences for option-ID tokens as a major source of multiple-choice selection bias, while FairEval and MT-Bench document response-order effects in pairwise judgments ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . In their study of many-shot evaluation, Song et al. (2025) likewise find that changing response order or the symbols assigned to responses alters GPT-4o’s pairwise judgments; they combine evaluations across both transformations to mitigate these biases. Shi et al. (2025) further separate repetition stability, position consistency, and preference fairness. Our candidate identifiers move with their content, so the present experiment measures behavior across reordered menus without independently identifying these sources.
blocks.zh: 早期关于背景校准的研究表明,语言模型带有解答偏好,这些偏好会随着提示和演示变化而动摇几发预测(Zhao等人,2021年). 当问答内容被固定时(Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024),选项重排提供了更直接的测试. 然而,必须区分立场和识别效应。 郑等. (2024)将选项ID符号的首选确定为多选择选择偏差的主要来源,而FairEval和MT-Bench在对偶判断中文档响应顺序效应(Wang等人,2023;Zheng等人,2023). Song等人(2025年)在研究多镜头评价时同样发现,改变反应顺序或给反应分配的符号会改变GPT-4o的双向判断;它们将两种转变的评价结合起来以减少这些偏差。 Shi等人(2025年)进一步单独重复稳定性,位置一致性,以及偏好公平. 我们的候选识别器随其内容而移动,所以目前的实验在不独立地识别这些来源的情况下,测量跨重排菜单的行为.

blocks.en: Contextual calibration and PriDe estimate answer priors to reduce bias ( Zhao et al., 2021 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . CalibraEval extends label-free calibration to LLM judges through an order-preserving transformation of prediction distributions ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Training offers another route. Strengthened symbol binding improves the association between an option and its identifier ( Xue et al., 2024 ) , while permutation-aware GRPO rewards consistency across rearrangements of the same instance ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Recent work also combines a probability-based permutation metric with LoRA fine-tuning and efficient aggregation ( Guda et al., 2025 ) . These interventions show that selection bias is responsive to both training and inference procedures. Evidence of reduced position bias in reasoning models on multi-document question answering further motivates comparison with current LLMs ( Li et al., 2026 ) . We evaluate the deployed systems without applying an additional debiasing method to any of them.
blocks.zh: 上下文校准和PriDe 估计答案为减少偏差(赵等人,2021年;郑等人,2024年). 卡利布拉语Name Eval通过对预测分布的定序-保存转换(Li等人,2024年)将无标签校准扩展至LLM判断. 培训提供另一种途径。 强化符号绑定可以改善选项与标识符之间的关联(Xue等人,2024年),而穿透-意识GRPO则奖励同一实例的重新安排的一致性(Zheng等人,2026年)。 最近的工作还结合了基于概率的演化度量表和LORA微调和高效的聚合(Guda等人,2025年)。 这些干预措施表明,选择偏向既能适应培训和推断程序。 多文件问题解答的推理模型中立场偏差减少的证据进一步激发了与当前法学硕士的比较(Li等人,2026年)。 我们评价已部署的系统,而不对其中任何系统采用额外的除雷方法。

blocks.en: Methods for reproducing Jev-style decisions differ in candidate representation, readout, and learning. LLM-as-Jev can even extract candidate probabilities from frozen causal LLMs ( Li and Wagle, 2026 ) , so the decision formulation alone does not identify an architectural or training intervention. Lukassen et al. (2026) compare eight typed decision models with seven LLM judges in pairwise evaluations, finding sensitivity to swapping two responses despite strong repeatability. Azizi et al. (2026) trace option-label effects to serialization in several public Jev-style implementations through interventions with weights fixed. These studies already establish that typed decisions need not be unbiased. We examine the cumulative consequences in multiple-choice tasks with four to 32 candidates. GRP evaluates each response pair in both orders and counts it as correct only when both judgments match the gold preference ( Song et al., 2026 ) . Asking for the worse response improves this joint criterion, without isolating gains in order agreement from gains in per-trial correctness. Ok et al. (2026) distinguish answer flipping from positional skew and show that aggregation can reduce flipping partly by stabilizing an incorrect answer. Their decomposition applies under balanced rotations, which our sampled permutations do not enforce. Likewise, the permutation metric of Guda et al. (2025) measures changes in candidate probabilities, whereas our analysis follows returned selections. We distinguish variation under repeated requests from variation under reordered menus, then test whether voting corrects errors and whether agreement identifies correct answers for Jev and the LLM baselines.

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10. 结论

blocks.en: A simple reordering test reveals a limitation of Jev-style System One models: stable accuracy and repeatable choices can conceal the loss of successful decisions. Across eight presentations of the primary collection, the two Jev versions’ failure sets expand by 27–29% while accuracy remains nearly unchanged. These losses are substantially smaller under original-order repetition, a gap also observed in highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Comparisons with LLMs establish no general Jev advantage. MMLU-Pro and GPQA Diamond show that the vulnerability persists at higher accuracy and with only four candidates. Voting offers limited correction for Jev, while unanimous errors show that agreement alone cannot certify correctness. Evaluating Jev-style structure therefore requires following individual correct choices across equivalent presentations; explaining their survival requires controlled comparisons of the designs behind the shared interface.
blocks.zh: 简单的重排测试揭示了Jev风格的System One模型的局限性:稳定的精度和可重复的选择可以掩盖成功决定的失败. 在主集的8个演示中,两个Jev版本的失败集扩大了27-29%,而准确性几乎没有变化。 在原订单重复的情况下,这些损失要小得多,在极易重复的Jev复制中也观察到这一缺口。 与LLMs的比较没有建立一般的Jev优势. MMLU-Pro和GPQA Diamond显示,脆弱性持续存在,准确性更高,只有四个候选人。 投票对Jev的更正有限,而一致的差错表明,仅凭协议无法证明正确。 因此,评价Jev风格的结构需要遵循单个正确的选择,通过等同的演示文稿;解释其生存情况需要对照共享界面背后的设计进行比较。

blocks.en: Candidate representations can depend on the request, rival options, and serialization position. Caching constrains their computation but not how later layers combine them: reusable options can support set-dependent decisions, while request-conditioned options can remain isolated from rivals (Figure 32 ). Order invariance and sensitivity to meaningful set changes are therefore separate properties.
blocks.zh: 候选人陈述可以取决于请求、竞争选择和序列化职位。 缓存会限制他们的计算,但不是后层如何结合:可重复使用的选项可以支持设定依赖的决定,而请求有条件的选项可以保持与对手的隔离(图32). 因此,顺序变化和对有意义的设定变化的敏感性是独立的属性。

blocks.en: CLM independently encodes state–instruction and action inputs, then compares their projected representations. If these inputs and the temperature remain fixed, adding an alternative changes the softmax denominator but not the odds between two existing alternatives. MetaEncoder also uses a shared bi-encoder and contrastive training, but supports multimodal requests and updates the encoder ( Cheng et al., 2026a ) . Its request-to-candidate InfoNCE is unidirectional, unlike CLM’s bidirectional objective. Moreover, its closed-set request template can include the alternatives, which are randomly dropped during training. Candidate features remain request-independent, but the request representation need not be independent of the set. Thus a bi-encoder label alone does not establish invariant pairwise odds.

blocks.en: Candidate-independent block-causal attention offers a third design ( Amit, 2026 ) . A causal request prefix is shared; each candidate block attends to that prefix and its own tokens, but not to other candidate blocks. Reset positions and a shared local score head aim to remove serialization-order effects. Candidate states therefore depend on the request and cannot generally be cached across different requests, even though their computation excludes other candidates. This is different from both independent bi-encoding and Jeva’s immutable option memory. The reported residual permutation flips also distinguish a structural design objective from exact numerical behavior. Its frozen contrastive baseline uses a different training setup, so that comparison does not isolate attention structure alone.
blocks.zh: 候选人-独立块-caus关注提供了第三个设计(Amit, 2026). . 共享一个因果请求前缀;每个候选区块都关注该前缀和自己的符号,但不关注其他候选区块. 重置位置和共享本地分数头旨在消除序列化-顺序效应. 因此,候选人所属国家依赖请求,一般不能在不同请求之间缓存,即使其计算排除了其他候选人。 这与独立双编码和Jeva的不可改变选项记忆不同。 所报道的剩余振荡翻转也区分了结构设计目标与精确的数值行为. 其冷冻的对比基准使用不同的训练设置,因此比较不会孤立注意力结构.

blocks.en: Prism-1 uses the same separation of a shared causal prefix and isolated candidate blocks, but scores each candidate with the native language-model head’s yes/no log odds at its final token ( Teng et al., 2026 ) . A softmax across these scores produces the choice distribution; LoRA and candidate cross-entropy adapt the model without a separate learned scalar head. Every candidate starts at the same position offset. For a fixed prefix and deterministic computation, isolation and position reuse make scores independent of candidate serialization order and preserve pairwise odds when unrelated candidates are added. The latter is a restriction as well as an invariance: a task requiring an existing option’s score to change with its rivals needs a different dependency structure.
blocks.zh: Prism-1使用一个共享的因果前缀和孤立的候选区块的相同分离,但每个候选区块在最终标志上以当地语言模型头的"是/否"(Teng等人,2026年)评分. 横跨这些分数的软max可以产生选择分布;LORA和候选的交叉拓扑(cross-entropy)可以在没有单独学习的scalar头的情况下对模型进行调整. 每名候选人从同一职位开始,请在平面上填写。 对于固定的前缀和确定性的计算,隔离和职位再利用使分数独立于候选人序列顺序,并在增加无关候选人时保持双向概率。 后者既是一种限制,也是一种变化:一项需要现有选择的得分才能与对手改变的任务需要不同的依赖结构。

blocks.en: Figure 32: Candidate reuse and interaction are separate choices. (a) Independent scoring, (b) set-dependent request refinement, and (c) request-conditioned candidate blocks. Arrows show dependencies; dashed outlines mark representations reusable with fixed inputs and weights. Odds statements fix request text, candidate text, and calibration.
blocks.zh: 图32:候选人再利用和互动是不同的选择。 (a) 独立评分,(b) 确定要求的改进,(c) 确定条件的候选区块。 箭头显示依赖性;虚线图示标记可重复使用固定输入和权重。 奇数语句固定请求文本、候选文本和校准。

blocks.en: C.3 Supervision and the Target Distribution
blocks.zh: C.3 监督和目标分配

blocks.en: Labels describe outcomes in the training population, contrastive pairs distinguish matched inputs from chosen negatives, and teacher probabilities reflect the teacher’s information and computation. Similar cross-entropy expressions can therefore fit different quantities.
blocks.zh: 标签描述培训人群中的成果,对比对子区分匹配的投入和选择的负数,教师概率反映教师的信息和计算. 因此,类似的横切表达式可以适应不同数量.

blocks.en: Jeff adds a residual decision head to the original letter readout and trains that head with backbone LoRA using cross-entropy ( Geuter et al., 2026 ) . The supervision mixes ordinary dataset labels, human uncertainty and ordinal annotations, and teacher-provided soft distributions. It is neither a pure hard-label recipe nor an RL method. Per-type temperature fitting follows training. The calibrated frozen model already provides a strong reference on the authors’ decision benchmark, while their knowledge-oriented comparisons still favor Jev. These results motivate a strong baseline; they do not establish equivalence across workloads.
blocks.zh: Jeff在原字母读出后增加了一个剩余决定头,并使用横切(Geuter等人,2026年)进行主干LORA头部的列车. 监管混合了普通数据集标签,人类不确定性和正则说明,以及教师提供的软分布. 它既不是一种纯粹的硬标签方法,也不是RL方法。 每型温度配装在训练后进行。 校准的冻结模型已经为作者的决定基准提供了有力的参考,而他们面向知识的比较仍然有利于Jev。 这些结果促使人们有一个强有力的基线;它们并没有确定工作量的等同性。

blocks.en: The adapted LLM-as-Jev variant instead preserves the architecture and candidate suffix representation ( Li and Wagle, 2026 ) . Its training loss uses a locally normalized candidate-prefix tree plus KL anchors that preserve the frozen model’s behavior on legal/illegal token mass and outside decision positions. That locally normalized training distribution should not be confused with the globally normalized suffix likelihood in Equation ( 8 ). The recipe uses public human-annotated training data rather than teacher-synthesized labels and studies both full adaptation and LoRA.
blocks.zh: 改编后的LLM-as-Jev变体反而保留了架构和候选后缀代表(Li and Wagle, 2026). 其培训损失使用当地规范的候选者前缀树加KL锚,保留被冻结的模型在合法/非法标志性物质和外部决策位置上的行为。 当地规范的培训分配不应与全球规范的方程式后缀可能性相混淆(8)。 食谱使用公共的人类附加说明的培训数据,而不是教师合成的标签,并研究完全适应和LORA两种方法.

blocks.en: Kev illustrates supervised adaptation with a different readout. Its pointer head projects the decision position and each option boundary into a shared space and normalizes scaled dot products over options. The released recipe uses cross-entropy; smaller models use LoRA, while the documented 27B model uses full-parameter adaptation. 8 8 8 Official implementation and recipe: https://github.com/jaredpalmer/kev . Optional permutation and ordinal losses exist in the code but are not part of the documented released-model recipe.
blocks.zh: Kev用不同的读数演示了有监督的适应。 它的指针头将决定位置和每个选项边界投放到一个共享的空间中,并使大小点产品比选项正常化. 发行的食谱使用跨内质;较小的模型使用LORA,而文献记载的27B模型则使用全参数的适应. 8 8 正式实施和配方:https://github.com/jaredpalmer/kev. 代码中存在可选的穿透和官阶损耗,但不属于有记录的发布型配方的一部分.

blocks.en: Intern-Decision instead retains the native vocabulary head and fits hard-label, full-vocabulary cross-entropy only at shifted decision positions ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) . Its input contains the complete ordered schema and an assistant JSON skeleton with <decision> placeholders. The logits immediately before each placeholder predict that field; earlier placeholders remain visible without feeding back gold or predicted answers. Inference restricts these logits to legal options and applies temperature scaling. The language parameters are adapted while the vision encoder and projector remain frozen. Training over the full vocabulary and restricting the inference readout are distinct operations, and the shared causal pass does not imply independence or order invariance across fields.
blocks.zh: 相反,实习决定保留了本地词汇头,并只在改变决定位置时才适用硬标签、全省横切(Zhu等人,2026年b)。 它的输入包含一个完整的订购的图案和一个带有<决定>占位符的JSON助手骨架. 在每个占位符之前的对数会预测这个字段;早期的占位符保持可见,而不反馈黄金或预测答案. 推论将这些对数限制在法律选项上,并应用温度缩放. 语言参数在视觉编码器和投影器保持冷冻的同时被调整. 对完整词汇的培训以及限制推断读取是不同的操作,共享的因果通行证并不意味着不同领域的独立性或秩序变化。

blocks.en: MJev-Spatial reuses pretrained query/key projections from the final full-attention layer to match a decision state to option-end states, rather than adding a prediction head ( Qin et al., 2026 ) . Mean scaled inner products across query heads become logits for one candidate softmax. The retained language parameters are trained with cross-entropy while the vision encoder and merger are frozen. Because option states come from a causal sequence, later options can see earlier ones; shuffling options during training does not establish structural permutation equivariance.
blocks.zh: MJev-Spatrial再利用从最终全注层预先训练的查询/键预测,以匹配一个决定状态到选项端状态,而不是添加一个预测头(秦等人,2026年). 平均比例的内置产品在查询头成为一个候选软马克的登录码。 保留的语言参数在视觉编码器和合并被冻结的同时,进行跨进式训练. 因为选项状态来自一个因果序列,后来的选项可以看到更早的选项;在训练期间的摇摆选项不会建立结构的演化等效.

blocks.en: Qwen-Audio-Jev uses a different design: a shared audio–language prefix state feeds three affine heads for 64 Choice indices, one binary Noul logit, and ten ordinal Score indices ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Candidate meanings are specified in the input, and each categorical head is normalized over the valid indices. Supervised training updates the audio encoder, adaptor, backbone, and heads using the observed primitive’s loss: Choice cross-entropy, binary cross-entropy, or ordinal cross-entropy with cumulative-distribution and expected-index penalties.
blocks.zh: Quen-Audio-Jev使用不同的设计:共享的音频-语言前缀状态为64个选择指数提供了3个辅音头,1个二进制Noul logit和10个正数分数指数(Fang等人,2026年). 在输入中指定了候选人的含义,每个绝对标题与有效指数相统一。 受监督的训练更新了音频编码器、适配器、骨干, 选择交叉交替,二进制交叉交替,或有累积分配和预期指数处罚的普通交叉交替交替.

blocks.en: Contrastive Language Models (CLM) use a frozen Qwen3-8B encoder with learned state and action projection heads. 9 9 9 Original technical blog: https://contrastive-lm.notion.site ; official implementation and reference-model recipe: https://github.com/Contrastive-LM/CLM . Matched state–action pairs supervise bidirectional InfoNCE: the state retrieves its matched action and the action retrieves its matched state among batch alternatives. At inference, state plus instructions and each candidate are encoded independently, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives the candidate distribution. Independent candidate representations can be cached, although different question instructions change the state encoding. This is learned contrastive alignment rather than teacher-probability distillation.
blocks.zh: Contrestive Language Models(CLM)使用冷冻的Qwen3-8B编码器,并带有学习的状态和动作投影头. 9 9 原创技术博客:https://contrastive-lm.notion.site. 官方执行与参考-模型食谱:https://github.com/Contrastive-LM/CLM. 匹配的状态 - 动作对导双向 InfoNCE : 状态检索其匹配的动作, 动作在批次选项中检索其匹配的状态 。 推论,状态加指令和每个候选人都是独立编码的,一个比缩放的余弦相似的软max会给候选人分配. 独立的候选代表可以缓存,尽管不同的问题指示会改变状态编码. 这是学习到的对比性校对,而不是教师-概率蒸馏。

blocks.en: SII-Decision trains a direct readout against a same-size backbone’s reasoning-conditioned predictions ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . For each question, two reasoning chains yield two candidate distributions; their mean becomes the cached student target. 10 10 10 JEVal Section 6.2 specifies a nonthinking-readout fallback for invalid chains, while Appendix F.4 describes excluding truncated, invalid, or top-option-disagreeing chains from added-source training data. Cross-entropy to this target is combined with a KL constraint to the original nonthinking prediction, and ordinal tasks also use an expected-level penalty. The student updates language layers while retaining the original label head, and inference uses a single prefill with no generated rationale. This is offline reasoning-to-readout self-distillation, not student on-policy rollout distillation.
blocks.zh: SII-Secretment根据相同大小的主干线的推理条件预测(Duan等人,2026年)进行直接读取。 对于每个问题,两个推理链产生两个候选分布;他们的平均值成为缓存的学生目标. 10 10 JEVal section 6.2对无效链规定了一个不思议的读取倒计时,而附录F.4则描述了将截断的,无效的,或首选的不赞同链从添加源培训数据中排除. 与这个目标的交叉进取结合的是KL对原始的非思维预测的制约,正线任务也使用预期级的处罚. 学生在保留原标签头的同时更新语言层,推论使用单个预填,没有生成理由. 这是离线推理到阅读的自我消化, 不是学生在政策上推出蒸馏。

blocks.en: Where SII retains reasoning-endpoint probabilities, LDM constructs soft targets from sampled answers ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . In the primary experiments, its SPRD variant draws four reasoning answers from a frozen Qwen3.8-27B teacher for all student sizes and forms a vote histogram normalized by the number of parseable answers. SPRD already requires the top vote share over all four samples to reach 0.75 0.75 ; SPRD-C additionally requires the majority to agree with the label intended during data construction. This checks consistency, not independent correctness. The LDM objective uses supervised NLL on one record type and weighted teacher-to-student KL on another, rather than applying both losses to every example.
blocks.zh: 在SII保留推理端点概率的地方,LDM从抽样答案中构建软目标(Chen等人,2026b.). 在初级实验中,它的SPRD变体从一个冻结的Quen3.8-27B老师中抽取了四个推理答案,用于所有学生大小,并形成一个投票直方图,通过解析答案的数量实现常态化. SPRD已经要求在所有四个样本中拥有最高票数份额,达到0.75 0.75;SPRD-C还要求多数同意数据构建期间打算使用的标签. 这检查一致性,而不是独立的正确性。 LDM目标在一个记录类型上使用受监督的NLL,在另一个记录类型上使用教师对学生加权的KL,而不是将两种损失都应用于每个例子.

(9) Averaging conditional probabilities removes the final-answer sampling noise under these assumptions. Different teachers, prompts, decoding rules, or sample filters can change the target marginal; Equation ( 9 ) does not establish equivalence between the actual SII and LDM datasets.

blocks.en: Teacher computation can also differ in depth rather than in the use of reasoning traces. FunDM freezes the backbone and trains a decision head on an intermediate hidden layer to match the full-depth model’s distribution using KL ( p teacher ∥ p student ) \mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{teacher}}\|p_{\mathrm{student}}) ( Panchal, 2026 ) . Inference can stop before the remaining layers, although the new head still requires training.
blocks.zh: 教师计算也可以在深度上不同,而不是在使用推理痕迹上不同. FunDM 冻结主干线,并在中间隐藏层上训练一个决定头,以匹配全深度模型使用 KL (p teacher Q∥ p student)\mathrm{ KL}(p_{\ mathrm{ teacher}}\|p_{\ mathrm{ student}})的分布. (Panchal, 2026) (英语). 推论可以在剩余层之前停止,虽然新头目仍然需要训练.

blocks.en: AutoTrust-JEV-27B uses output distributions obtained from TypeSafe Jev 1.13 as its main supervision stream. 11 11 11 Author model card and recipe: https://huggingface.co/autotrust/JEV-27B . Its training corpus also contains programmatic labels and downweighted uniform-placeholder targets. The documented recipe fits LoRA adapters and a decision head using target-to-student KL, with an ordinal ranked probability score (RPS) term. The service-target component is behavioral imitation of a black-box model. Agreement with that teacher is a different outcome from correctness against independent labels, and it does not identify the teacher’s internal training algorithm. External-teacher models such as Eikos and Torchcast provide further distribution-fitting variants, catalogued in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: AutoTrust-JEV-27B使用从TypeSafe Jev 1.13获得的输出分布作为其主监督流. 11 11 作者模式卡和食谱:https://huggingface.co/autotrust/JEV-27B. 其培训内容还包括方案标签和减量的统一位置目标。 所记录的食谱符合LORA适配器和决定头使用目标对学生的KL,并带有一个正数排名概率分数(RPS)术语. 服务目标组件是行为模仿黑盒模型. 与该教师达成一致是不同于正确性与独立标签的结果,它无法识别该教师的内部培训算法。 Eikos和Torchcast等外部教师模式提供了进一步的配给性变体,列于附录一。

blocks.en: These teacher targets differ in the information and computation they retain (Figure 33 ).
blocks.zh: 这些教师目标的信息和计算各不相同(图33)。

blocks.en: Figure 33: Four sources of teacher targets. (a) Averaged endpoint probabilities, (b) sampled-answer votes, (c) full-depth predictions, and (d) AutoTrust service outputs, excluding its other target sources. Vectors in (a,b) are illustrative; (b) assumes four parseable samples. Dotted gold arrows carry fixed targets; dashed arrows mark updated components. Student inference omits teacher computation.
blocks.zh: 图33:教师目标的四个来源。 (a) 平均终点概率,(b) 抽样答案,(c) 全面深入预测,(d) 自动信任服务产出,不包括其他目标来源。 (a,b)中的矢量是说明性的;(b)假定四个可解析的样品。 点缀的金箭带有固定的目标;破折的箭头标记更新的组件. 学生推论省略教师计算.

blocks.en: Some models are trained to support a particular workflow. LAVOIR adds slot representations and a value-of-information head to Laya, trained with decision cross-entropy and value regression ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) . The final recipe sets the inherited RL weight to zero. The model learns both a decision distribution and estimates used by the ask/decide/handoff policy in Appendix E.2.1 .
blocks.zh: 一些模型接受过支持特定工作流程的培训. LAVOIR为Laya添加了插槽表示和信息值头,并接受了关于决定交叉内涵和价值回归的培训(Yilmaz等人,2026年)。 最后的食谱将继承的RL重量设定为零. 该模型学习了附录E.2.1中询问/决定/处理政策所用的决定分配和估计。

blocks.en: AgentDecision-4B, introduced in JevAgentHarness, trains the decision component on agent states ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Its Qwen3-4B LoRA recipe includes post-error states from mistake replay. When Jev’s top option matches the gold label, the supervised target mixes 0.3 0.3 gold one-hot mass with 0.7 0.7 teacher probabilities; otherwise it uses the gold label alone. Cross-entropy plus a Brier term precedes closed-loop GRPO with a fixed LLM, task-success and cost/error rewards, and a KL anchor to the supervised model. Here environment feedback updates the decision model itself. Appendix E.3 examines the different role of a fixed Jev service guiding another learner.
blocks.zh: JevAgent Harness介绍的代理决定-4B在代理状态(Zhu等人,2026a)上培训决定成分. 其 Quen3-4B (中文(简体) ). LoRA配方包括错误重播后的后反应状态. 当Jev的顶级选项与金牌匹配时,被监督的目标将0.3金的一热质量与0.7的教师概率混合;否则它单独使用金牌. Cross-entropy加上一个Brier术语在闭路GRPO之前,有固定的LLM,任务成功和成本/错误的奖励,以及KL锚定在受监督的模型. 在此,环境反馈更新了决策模式本身。 附录E.3审查了指导另一个学习者的固定Jev服务的不同作用。

blocks.en: C.4 Statistical Objectives and Gradient Credit
blocks.zh: C.4 统计目标和逐步信贷

blocks.en: A proper probability score defines an objective for truthful reporting; a gradient estimator determines how its training signal reaches the parameters. For a distribution p p and outcome y y , log score log ⁡ p y \log p_{y} and negative Brier score − ∑ k ( p k − 𝟏 [ k = y ] ) 2 -\sum_{k}(p_{k}-\mathbf{1}[k=y])^{2} reward truthful probability reports in expectation. A differentiable readout can optimize either score directly. By contrast, rewarding only a sampled answer’s correctness maximizes ∑ k p k ​ q k \sum_{k}p_{k}q_{k} under outcome distribution q q , generally favoring a mode of q q rather than reporting q q . Thus the word “RL” identifies neither the statistical property being optimized nor an advantage over direct proper-score fitting.
blocks.zh: 适当的概率分数界定了真实报告的目标;梯度估计器确定其训练信号如何达到参数。 对于分布 p 和结果 y , 日志分数日志 QQ p y\log p_{y )和负 Brier 分数 − k (p k - 1 [k=y] (中文(简体) ). 2 -\ sum_{k} (p_{k} -\ mathbf{1} [k=y]) (中文(简体) ). 在预期中奖励真实的概率报告。 不同的读出可以直接优化任一分数. 相比之下,在结果分配q q q 下,只奖励一个抽样答案的正确性最大化了 Q k p k q k\ sum_{k}p_{k}q_{k},一般倾向于q q的模式而不是报告q q. 因此,“RL”一词既未说明正在优化的统计属性,也未说明相对于直接适当计分配制而言有何优势。

blocks.en: Figure 34 contrasts direct differentiation, output-space perturbations, and rationale-policy credit. OpenJev-RLCD, the rationale-policy method depicted here, retains generated reasoning at inference; this is a property of that method rather than a requirement of every rationale-based training procedure.
blocks.zh: 图34对比了直接差异、产出-空间扰动和理由政策信用。 OpenJev-RLCD是本文中描述的推理政策方法,它保留了推论中生成的推理;这是这种方法的一个属性,而不是每个基于推理的培训程序的要求.

blocks.en: Figure 34: Three paths for learning signals. (a) Direct differentiation, (b) output-space score-function credit supplementing soft cross-entropy, and (c) direct answer-readout gradients with second-stage rationale-policy credit. Here b b is a baseline, q q a fixed target, and sg \operatorname{sg} stop-gradient. Schematics omit centering, normalization, and auxiliary regularizers; they compare mechanisms, not measured estimator advantages.
blocks.zh: 图34:学习信号的三条路径. (a) 直接区分,(b) 产出-空间计分功能信贷,以软性交叉竞争为补充,(c) 具有第二阶段理由-政策信贷的直接回答-读出梯度。 这里的bb是一个基线,q q是一个固定目标,和 sg\operatorname{sg} 停止升级。 外形学省略了中心化,正常化,和辅助的常态器;它们比较了机制,而不是测量的估计优势.

blocks.en: Laya and Chinese-Jev perturb output logits and apply policy-gradient updates in that space; Chinese-Jev combines soft cross-entropy with Gaussian perturbations around detached logits and a group-baseline estimator ( Wang et al., 2026c ) . This does not require a generated chain of thought. The decider-derived this-that-model combines CE and Brier terms with a sampled-outcome Brier reward and a control-variate estimator ( Cheng et al., 2026b ) . Another output-policy variant, decider-2B v10, uses PPO over environment actions with terminal returns and an auxiliary proper-log-score belief objective; the documented 4B and 35B releases do not use that RL stage. 12 12 12 Version-specific recipe: https://github.com/Mapika/decider/blob/main/docs/RL.md . These methods apply stochastic policy updates in output space rather than over generated reasoning. Their estimators, stop-gradient choices, and rewards determine what those updates contribute beyond direct fitting.
blocks.zh: Laya和Chinese-Jev perturb 输出日志,并在该空间应用政策级更新;Chinese-Jev 将柔性交叉条目和高斯语扰动围绕脱落日志和一个群基线估计器(Wang等人,2026c.)结合. 这不需要产生一个思想链。 由决定者衍生的这种模式将CE和Brier术语与抽样结果的Brier奖励和可控变量估计词(Cheng等人,2026年b)结合起来。 另一种产出政策变体,决定者-2B v10, 使用PPO来代替环境行动, 具有终端返回和辅助的正则记录-分数的信念目标; 文件记载的4B和35B的发布没有使用RL阶段. 12 12 版本特定配方: https://github.com/Mapika/decider/blob/main/docs/RL.md. 这些方法在输出空间中应用有条理的政策更新,而不是过度生成推理. 他们的估算器,停止升级的选择,以及奖励,决定了这些更新对直接适应之外的贡献。

blocks.en: Qwen-Audio-Jev makes this distinction explicit with an importance-weighted, pairwise sampled-action estimator for negative Brier score and ordinal RPS ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Its exploration mixture, leave-one-out baseline, and detached weights yield the direct proper-score gradient in expectation under the stated construction. Thus the estimator need not define a different probability target from direct fitting. This equivalence does not establish an empirical advantage in variance, efficiency, or calibration.
blocks.zh: Quen-Audio-Jev明确了这种区别,为负Brier得分和正数RPS配有加权、对等的抽样动作估计器(Fang等人,2026年)。 其勘探混合物、 " 一离一 " 基线和离散权重,在所述构造下产生预期的直接适当分数梯度。 因此,估计者不需要界定与直接安装不同的概率目标。 这种等同性并不确立差异、效率或校准方面的经验优势。

blocks.en: OpenJev-RLCD first calibrates an answer distribution conditioned on sampled rationales, then adds REINFORCE credit to the rationale policy using the same proper score ( Gao and Wang, 2026 ) . If J ( θ ) = 𝔼 r ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ x ) [ S ( p θ ( ⋅ ∣ x , r ) , y ) ] , J(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{r\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x)}[S(p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x,r),y)], (10) then its two relevant gradient paths are the differentiable readout term and the score-function term through π θ ​ ( r ∣ x ) \pi_{\theta}(r\mid x) . Stage one uses the former; stage two adds the latter, with a baseline and KL regularization. Its main experiments score each rationale’s distribution separately and retain explicit rationales at inference. It is an independent RLCD interpretation, not a disclosed implementation of proprietary Jev.
blocks.zh: OpenJev-RLCD首先校准一个以抽样理由为条件的解答分配,然后使用相同的适当分数(Gao和Wang, 2026)将REINFORCE信用加到原理策略中. 如果J( ) = E r = π ( ⋅ ⋅ ( ⋅,  r,  y) [S (p θ ( ⋅,  r,  r,  r)] , J(\theta) =\ mathb{ E}_{r\sim\pi_{\theta} (\cdot\mid x, r, y)], (10)则其两个相关的梯度路径是不同的可读出词和通过 π (  r,  r)\pi_{\theta}(r\mid x) ). 第一阶段采用前者;第二阶段增加后者,并附有基线和KL正规化。 其主要实验对每个理由的分布分别进行评分,在推论上保留明确的理由. 它是一种独立的RLCD解释,而不是公开的专有Jev的执行.

blocks.en: StartLux combines instant decision learning with an AutoThink variant that allocates reasoning conditionally ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) . Its instant model makes full-attention layers bidirectional while retaining causal linear-attention layers. RLCD 2 uses a frozen reference model’s before/after probability signal to train a reasoning-token policy. Within groups containing only nonempty traces, the initial-score term cancels under reward centering; empty traces receive zero reward, so this cancellation does not extend to arbitrary mixed groups. PostHog’s Jeeves is another reasoning-policy implementation: its repository combines supervised learning, CISPO-style updates, a pointer head, and a diffusion drafter. Its documented reward uses correct-answer probability with a length penalty, which should not automatically be called a proper scoring rule.
blocks.zh: StartLux将即时决定学习与AutoThink变体结合,有条件地分配推理( Zhu等,2026). 其即时模型在保留因果线性意向层的同时,使全注层双向. RLCD 2使用冷冻的参考模型在概率信号之前/之后来训练一个推理计数政策. 在只包含非空痕的组内,初始得分期在奖励中心下取消;空痕得到零奖励,因此这种取消不延伸至任意混合组. 员额 Hog's Jeeves是另一个推理政策执行:它的存储库结合了有监督的学习,CISPO式的更新,指针头,以及推广起草器. 其有记载的奖励使用有长度处罚的正确回答概率,不应自动称为适当的评分规则.

Figure 35 contrasts computation shared across questions (a–b) with computation adapted within a decision (c–d). Both affect cost, while routing and output transformations can also change the returned prediction.
