blocks.en: D.1 Direct Outputs and Adaptive Computation
blocks.zh: D.1 直接产出和适应性计算

blocks.en: A direct student may omit its teacher’s reasoning, an intermediate head may omit later layers, and a recurrent model may perform additional hidden steps without generating text. Conditional reasoning introduces another possibility, mixing direct and deliberative requests behind one interface. These choices change different resources, so generated-token count alone cannot compare their computational demands.
blocks.zh: 直接的学生可能会省略老师的推理,中间头可能省略后层,经常出现的模型可能执行额外的隐藏步骤而不产生文字. 有条件的推理引入了另一种可能性,将直接请求和审议请求放在一个界面后面。 这些选择会改变不同的资源,因此单独生成的托肯计数无法比较它们的计算需求.

blocks.en: LDM routes low-margin items to the student’s untuned base for one reasoning rollout and adopts its answer; the direct branch keeps the readout’s answer (Figure 35 c; Chen et al., 2026b ). Its threshold is the validation margins’ 30th percentile, which does not fix the routed fraction on unseen data. StartLux AutoThink instead uses the same model weights for the initial causal readout, reasoning, and endpoint readout (Figure 35 d; Zhuang et al., 2026 ). With a maximum initial probability below 0.9 0.9 , it generates up to 4,096 reasoning tokens and returns 0.25 ​ p 0 + 0.75 ​ p 1 0.25p_{0}+0.75p_{1} ; otherwise it returns p 0 p_{0} . These routes differ in the model called, the trigger, and the returned prediction.
blocks.zh: LDM将低边际物品引向学生未调整的基础,进行一次推理推开并采用其答案;直接分支保留读出答案(图35c;Chen等人,2026b). 其阈值为验证边距的30百分位, 开始 Lux AutoThink转而对初始因果读出,推理和端点读出使用相同的模型权重(图35d; Zhu等,2026年). 其初始最大概率低于0.9 0.9,生成最多4,096个推理符,并返回0.25 p + 0.75 p 1 0.25p_{0}+0.75p_{1};否则返回p 00}0}. 这些路线在所谓的模型,触发器,以及返回的预测上各不相同.

blocks.en: Latent loops allocate extra computation without generating a textual rationale. SanSi repeatedly applies a recurrent backbone and reads a decision distribution after each loop ( Gan et al., 2026 ) . The base weights are frozen, while shared LoRA adapters and loop-specific readout corrections are learned. Cross-entropy and Brier losses supervise the loop outputs, with gradients passing through preceding loops. The paper trains with eight loops and evaluates different loop counts. Latent computation thus varies separately from parameter count and generated-token count, and additional loops need not improve every task.
blocks.zh: Latent 环路在不产生文字理由的情况下分配额外计算. SanSi反复应用一个经常性的骨干,并在每圈之后读出一个决定分布(Gan等人,2026年). 基重被冻结,同时共享LORA适配器和循环专用读出校正被学习. Cross-entropy和Brier损失对循环输出进行监督,梯度通过之前的循环. 纸质列车有8个环路,评价不同的环路计数. 因此,Latet计算与参数计数和生成-token计数不同,额外的循环不需要改进每个任务.

blocks.en: Selective Reasoning instead exposes three control decisions: when to start generation, when to read a partial rationale, and when to accept the current answer ( Zheng and Chen, 2026 ) . A reader is trained on empty and partial reasoning prefixes using a frozen backbone. The start gate estimates correction benefit relative to regression risk, the read scheduler limits costly reader calls, and the accept rule uses the reader’s distribution. An accepted prefix answer cancels generation only if generation is still active. If no prefix answer is accepted, a terminal read returns an answer without a certainty requirement. Thus the entropy threshold governs early acceptance rather than guaranteeing the confidence of every returned answer. The threshold itself measures distribution concentration, not an independently measured probability of correctness.
blocks.zh: 选择性理性反而暴露了三种控制决定:何时开始生成,何时读取部分理由,何时接受当前答案(郑和陈,2026). 使用冷冻骨干对读者进行空的和部分推理前缀的培训. 启动门估计校正相对于回归风险的好处,阅读调度器限制昂贵的读者通话,接受规则使用读者的发行. 一个被接受的前缀答案只有在生成仍然活跃的情况下才会取消生成. 如果不接受前缀答案,一个终端读取返回一个没有确定性要求的答案. 因此,肽阈值规范了早期接受,而不是保证每个返回的答案具有信心. 阈值本身衡量分布浓度,而不是独立测量的正确概率.

blocks.en: FastJEV changes the execution of an existing decision model without weight training ( Ma et al., 2026a ) . It reuses shared context and recurrent states, forks candidate-prefix caches, and selects a candidate-path layer-skipping mask using relative-score perturbations on unlabeled calibration inputs. These mechanisms preserve the context and candidate inventory while changing the work performed on candidate paths. Prefix reuse can reduce computation yet increase latency through execution overhead. Its results therefore support a serving analysis under specified workloads, rather than a universal latency improvement. The OmniJev model evaluated in that paper should not be conflated with the separately named OneJev repository.
blocks.zh: FastJEV在不进行重量培训的情况下改变现有决定模式的执行(Ma等人,2026a). 它重新使用共享上下文和经常状态,叉子候选人-前缀缓存,并选择一个在无标签校准输入上使用相对比分扰动的候选路径层吸附面罩. 这些机制保留了背景和候选人清单,同时改变了在候选人途径上开展的工作。 前缀复用可以通过执行间接费用来降低计算但提高耐久性. 因此,其结果支持在特定工作量下进行服务分析,而不是普遍改进延迟。 该文件所评价的OmniJev模型不应与单独命名的OneJev寄存器合并。

blocks.en: Comparing these paths requires accounting for backbone depth, reader calls, generation, caching, and scheduling. Returned-answer length alone does not measure their cost.
blocks.zh: 比较这些路径需要考虑主干深度、读者呼叫、生成、缓存和时间安排。 单靠返回的回答长度并不能衡量它们的成本。

blocks.en: MJev-Spatial illustrates a further distinction between the primitive and the completed prediction ( Qin et al., 2026 ) . A categorical answer uses one decision, while spatial point prediction uses three successive nine-way cell choices. The first two choices determine new crops from the original image, which are re-encoded for the next stage. Training packs teacher-forced stages into one backbone pass, but inference must follow the predicted crops sequentially. The spatial quantization bound assumes the correct cell choices; it is not a bound on model prediction error. Single-pass training, single-pass primitive scoring, and single-pass task inference are therefore separate claims.
blocks.zh: MJev-Spaceal进一步说明了原始人与完成预测之间的区别(秦等人,2026年). 一个绝对的答案使用一个决定,而空间点预测则使用三个连续的九向细胞选择. 前两种选择从原始图像中决定新的作物,这些作物被重新编码为下一阶段. 培训将教师强化阶段打包成一个骨干通道,但推断必须依次跟踪预测的作物。 空间量化约束假设正确的细胞选择;它不是模型预测错误的约束. 因此,单行道训练、单行道原始评分和单行道任务推断是单独的主张。

blocks.en: D.2 Serving and the Returned Prediction
blocks.zh: D.2 服役和返回的预测

blocks.en: The model head is only one stage of a deployed prediction. Postprocessing can move its probability mass, scalar reduction can retain different information, and question batching can change how computation is shared. Behavior observed through a service can therefore reflect transformations applied after training as well as the learned distribution.
blocks.zh: 模型头只是部署预测的一个阶段. 后处理可以移动其概率质量,scalar还原可以保留不同的信息,而问题批量可以改变如何共享计算. 因此,通过某项服务观察到的行为可以反映培训后的转变以及学到的知识分布。

blocks.en: The same typed interface can expose different question-processing graphs. Kev’s documented hybrid-backbone implementation processes separate causal question rows and can reuse a state cache in serving (Figure 35 a). Cloudflare Clef instead uses a joint schema head and describes one forward pass for all questions (Figure 35 b). Jeff’s released server evaluates questions serially, while official Jev describes shared-state parallel question processing. These differences determine how computation is shared even when each question returns the same output type.
blocks.zh: 同样的打字界面可以曝光不同的问题处理图表. Kev所记录的混合-背骨执行过程将因果问题行分开,在服务中可以重用状态缓存(图35 a). Cloudflare Clef转而使用联合计划头并描述所有问题的一个前传(图35b). Jeff发布的服务器对问题进行连续评价,而官方Jev则描述了共享状态平行问题处理. 这些差异决定了即使在每个问题返回相同的输出类型时如何共享计算.

blocks.en: Documented readouts do not always identify a training recipe. Perplexity’s decider v1.1 describes a separate 255-row readout and saved temperature calibration, but the public model cards for decider and Clef do not specify their training objectives (Appendix I ). JevK5 further describes a one-pass readout only up to its candidate limit and a multi-pass tournament beyond it. Candidate limits and question organization are therefore necessary conditions for interpreting an execution claim.
blocks.zh: 记录下来的宣读并不总是能发现培训方法。 Perplexity的决策者v1.1描述了单独的255行读出并节省了温度校准,但决定者和克莱夫的公共模型卡并没有具体说明他们的训练目标(附录一). JevK5进一步描述了只达到其候选人限制的单路通读和超出其范围的多路通联赛. 因此,候选人限制和提问组织是解释执行要求的必要条件。

blocks.en: Jeff illustrates how postprocessing can change the apparent decisiveness of a model. Its default binary “commitment” transformation moves intermediate probabilities beyond the benchmark’s abstention interval. The returned distribution therefore differs from the temperature-calibrated distribution before this transformation, and an evaluation of calibration must specify which one it measures. Reduced abstention under this rule cannot be attributed to the cross-entropy training objective alone.
blocks.zh: Jeff说明了后处理如何可以改变模型的明显决定性. 它的默认二进制“承诺”转换使中间概率超过基准弃权间隔。 因此,返回的分布不同于这次转变之前的温度校准分布,对校准的评价必须具体说明它衡量的是哪一种。 根据本条减少的弃权不能仅仅归因于交叉参与的培训目标。

blocks.en: SII returns the expected ordinal level, whereas Jeff’s released scalar field returns an argmax level. Identical categorical distributions can therefore yield different scalar answers.
blocks.zh: SII 返回预期的正数级, 而 Jeff 释放的 scalar 字段返回一个 logmax 级 。 因此,同样的绝对分布可以产生不同的分级答案。

blocks.en: Appendix E Decision Models in Downstream Workflows
blocks.zh: 附录E 下游工作流程中的决定模式

blocks.en: The consequence of a decision depends on where it intervenes in a task. We distinguish control of an ongoing trajectory, selection among completed outcomes, acquisition of evidence, and assistance to another learner. These roles carry different error and recovery costs, even when they use the same decision model.
blocks.zh: 决定的后果取决于它在哪里干预一项任务。 我们区分了对持续轨迹的控制、对已完成成果的选择、证据的获取以及对另一个学习者的援助。 这些角色有不同的错误和回收成本,即使它们使用相同的决策模式。

blocks.en: E.1 Controlling a Trajectory or Selecting Its Outcome
blocks.zh: E.1 控制轨迹或选择轨迹结果

blocks.en: Online selection changes which state the agent reaches next. Completed-run selection instead chooses among trajectories whose generation cost has already been incurred. Both can use a fast scorer, but only the former changes the actions within an individual run. This distinction determines which generator, candidate budget, and executor must remain fixed to attribute a downstream gain to the decision component.
blocks.zh: 在线选择更改, 显示代理到达下一个 。 已完成运行的选择则选择已经产生成本的轨道。 两者都可以使用快速计分器,但只有前者在单个运行内改变动作. 这种区分决定了哪些产生者、候选人的预算和执行者必须保持不变,以便将下游收益归于决策部分。

blocks.en: Jev Ultrafast constructs a dynamic action space from the observed browser state. 13 13 13 Primary implementation: https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast , especially “The action space” and “Evidence and limits.” Each observation supplies an indexed table of elements. A single Jev request asks for both an operation and speculative targets for the supported operation types. The executor uses only the target corresponding to the selected operation (Figure 36 a). A small LLM supplies text when the operation requires typing. Ordinary code checks target compatibility and page freshness, executes the action, and obtains the next observation.
blocks.zh: Jev Ultrafast从观测到的浏览器状态构建了动态动作空间。 13 13 初级执行:https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast,特别是“动作空间”和“证据和限制 ” 。 每项观察都提供一份指数化的元素表。 一项Jev请求要求为所支持的行动类型确定一个行动和投机目标。 执行器只使用与选定操作相对应的目标(图36 a). 当操作需要打字时,一个小的 LLM 提供文本. 普通代码检查目标兼容性和页面新鲜度,执行动作,并获得下一次观察.

blocks.en: The division of labor depends on enumerating actionable choices from the environment. The decision model selects within that interface, while generation remains available for open-ended content. Selection of a DONE action still needs an independent outcome check. The repository reports a small set of demonstrations and repeated runs on one browser task; these establish an implemented loop, not general reliability or an isolated effect of the decision model.
blocks.zh: 分工取决于从环境中列举出可采取行动的选择。 决策模式在该界面内选择,而生成仍可用于开放式内容。 选择指定任务的行动仍然需要独立的结果检查。 寄存器报告一个浏览器任务上的一小组演示和重复运行;这些操作建立了已执行的循环,而不是一般的可靠性或决定模型的孤立效果.

blocks.en: JevCoder exposes a related boundary in code repair ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Its components recommend code snippets, guide action types, and judge whether to submit or continue. When Jev selects an action type, an LLM still generates the specific command. A judge that blocks a command does not thereby supply a better one, and some blocking interventions hurt performance. The full-workflow experiments are separate from component studies on selected success/failure panels; they should not be pooled as a single task-success estimate. Each full-workflow task receives one run per condition, which limits what can be inferred about repeated-run variability.
blocks.zh: JevCoder在代码修复中暴露了相关的边界(张等,2026年). 它的组件推荐代码片段,引导动作类型,判断是提交还是继续. Jev选择动作类型时,LLM仍然生成特定命令. 阻断命令的法官不会提供更好的命令,有些阻断干预会损害业绩。 完全工作流程实验与关于选定成功/失败面板的组件研究分开;它们不应作为单一的任务成功估计集合。 每个全工作流程任务每个条件都得到一次运行,这限制了对重复运行的可变性的推断.

blocks.en: A decision gate can replace a local choice, advise a generator, reject an action, trigger extra work, or escalate uncertain cases. JevAgentHarness implements these roles at tool selection, bounded arguments, memory operations, reflection, stopping, and model routing ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Its deployment cascade compares the maximum option probability with thresholds fitted for each decision point using held-out shadow trajectories and intervention costs. Free-form arguments still require an LLM. The gate’s confidence and the harness’s policy jointly determine behavior; a threshold alone does not establish safe execution. The same work also trains a decision model and evaluates controllers, which are distinct contributions (Appendices C.3 and F ).
blocks.zh: 决策门可以替代本地选择,建议生成者,拒绝动作,触发额外工作,或者使不确定情况升级. JevAgentHarness在工具选择,边框参数,内存操作,反射,停止以及模型路由(Zhu等人,2026a)中执行这些角色. 其部署级联利用搁置的阴影轨迹和干预费用,将最大选择概率与每个决定点的阈值进行比较。 Free-form 参数仍需要 LLM. 关卡的信心和支配政策共同决定了行为;仅凭门槛并不能确定安全执行。 同一工作还培训一个决策模式,并对控制器进行评估,这些控制器是独特的贡献(附录C.3和F)。

blocks.en: Jev-LiteMAS specializes this division of labor to a predefined pool of generative experts ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Jev selects the next expert or, when eligible, STOP, and screens artifacts for acceptance or escalation. On escalation, an LLM reviewer supplies a verdict and textual feedback; an expert revises the artifact, which is then screened again. The decision model does not generate repair instructions, and local artifact acceptance is distinct from stopping the entire workflow. Savings therefore depend on the escalation frequency and on whether the resulting artifacts still satisfy the task.
blocks.zh: Jev-LiteMAS将这种分工专门用于预先确定的基因专家库(Wang等人,2026a). Jev选择下一位专家,或者,在合格时,停止,并筛选文物接受或升级. 关于升级,一名LLM审查员提供判决和文字反馈;一名专家修改文物,然后再次筛选。 决策模式不产生修复指令,当地文物验收不同于停止整个工作流程. 因此,能否节省经费取决于升级频率,取决于由此产生的文物是否仍能完成任务。

blocks.en: Jarvis applies typed control to an asynchronous task ledger ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Runtime code constructs eligible operations tied to task identifiers and versions; the decision model selects among them from the transcript, history, and ledger. Low-confidence cases delegate to a worker without speculative ledger mutation. Code enforces one live version, rejects stale results, revalidates plans, and requires a playback receipt before marking speech as delivered. These invariants belong to the executor, not to the model’s probability estimates. The paper also trains a separate audio LISTEN/DIRECT/DELEGATE gate; that learned gate and the downstream ledger policy should not be treated as one training mechanism.
blocks.zh: Jarvis将打字控制应用于同步任务分类账(Wang等人,2026b.). 运行时代码构建与任务识别符和版本捆绑的合格操作;决定模型从记录,历史和分类账中选择其中. 不信任案委托给一个没有投机分类账突变的工人。 代码执行一个直播版本,拒绝 Stale results, 重新验证计划,并要求在发送的语音标记前获得回放收据. 这些变量属于执行者,而不是模型的概率估计。 文件还培训一个单独的音频Listen/DIRECT/DELEGATE门;学习的门和下游分类账政策不应被当作一个培训机制。

blocks.en: A penetration-testing harness study illustrates how several decision roles can coexist in one domain ( Barbosa, 2026 ) . Typed decisions support finding adjudication, severity assessment, agent pruning, and bounded confirmation, while the harness retains evidence gates and execution. Its exploratory comparison uses one run per condition on one target, and subsequent retests change the harness. The study demonstrates this division of labor, but the separate effects of the decision model and harness remain unresolved. Establishing a benefit would require comparing the same task decomposition and execution policy with alternative decision components.
blocks.zh: 一项渗透测试带研究表明,若干决策作用如何在一个领域共存(Barbosa,2026年)。 类型决定支持裁决、严重性评估、代理人调查以及有限度的确认,同时保留证据门和执行。 它的探索性比较使用在一个目标上每个条件一次运行,随后的重新测试会改变牵引力. 研究显示了这种分工,但决策模式和利用的各自影响仍未得到解决。 要确定好处,就需要将相同的任务分解和执行政策与备选决定部分进行比较。

blocks.en: E.2 Changing the Evidence Available to a Decision
blocks.zh: (单位:千美元) 将现有证据改为决定

blocks.en: The preceding workflows use the available evidence to choose behavior or an outcome. Clarification obtains an external answer, while memory control changes how past evidence is organized and retrieved. These operations can improve a later decision without changing the decision model’s parameters. Their benefits and costs therefore depend on the information acquired, as well as the quality of the local probability report.
blocks.zh: 以上工作流程使用现有证据选择行为或结果. 澄清获得一个外部答案,而内存控制会改变过去证据的组织和检索方式. 这些行动可以在不改变决定模式参数的情况下改进以后的决定。 因此,它们的效益和成本取决于所获得的信息以及当地概率报告的质量。

blocks.zh: E.2.1 获取缺失信息

blocks.en: Clarification changes the source of information available to the model. LDM and StartLux conditional thinking process the existing input through an internal rationale, whereas LAVOIR obtains an external answer. It also goes beyond deferring low-confidence cases by ranking particular missing fields by predicted benefit. The evidence is strongest for synthetic multi-turn dialogues, with limited real single-exchange tests and one training seed. Comparisons against slower value-of-information computation and an LLM agent remain incomplete, leaving open whether the learned acquisition policy offers a better quality–cost trade-off across interaction settings.
blocks.zh: 澄清改变了模型的信息来源。 LDM和StartLux有条件的思维通过内部理由处理现有的输入,而LAVOIR则获得外部答案. 它还超越了推迟低信心案件,按照预期效益对特定缺失字段进行排序。 合成多回合对话的证据最强,真实的单次交换测试和一次训练种子有限。 与较慢的信息价值计算和LLM代理的比较仍未完成,尚不清楚所学的获取政策能否提供更好的质量-成本权衡。

blocks.en: E.2.2 Controlling Memory Construction and Retrieval
blocks.zh: E.2.2 控制内存建设和检索

blocks.en: Jev-Mem places a decision controller between stored observations and an LLM answerer ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Its contribution is the organization of memory operations around fast typed decisions, rather than a new recipe for training the controller. Shared canonical memory nodes participate in semantic, temporal, causal, and entity relation views. Figure 37 separates writing this memory from retrieving evidence, because the decision objects and feedback loops differ.
blocks.zh: Jev-Mem在存储的观测和LLM回答器之间放置了决定控制器(Jiang等人,2026年). 它的贡献是围绕快速输入的决定组织内存操作,而不是训练控制器的新食谱. 共享的cononical内存节点参与语义,时间,因果,和实体关系视图. 图37将写这个内存与检索证据区分开来,因为决策对象和反馈环路不同.

blocks.en: Figure 37: Jev-Mem controls memory writing and retrieval ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . (a) Writing preserves observations and judges relations. (b) Retrieval iteratively acquires evidence before answer synthesis. Four graph views share memory nodes. Arrows span multiple operations and calls; colors follow Figure 31 .
blocks.zh: 图37:Jev-Mem控制内存书写和检索(Jiang等人,2026年). (a)书写保存观察和判官关系. (b) 在回答综合之前反复获取证据。 四个图视图共享内存节点. 箭头横跨多个操作和调用;颜色跟随图31.

blocks.en: Incoming observations retain their original text and provenance. The controller annotates overlapping memory characteristics, while deterministic vector, lexical, entity, and time search produces a bounded set of candidate neighbors. The controller then judges inferred relations; thresholds determine which edges are added. Reliable timestamp ordering and exact identifiers can be handled directly by code. Thus the normal write path does not ask the model to irreversibly discard observations before their future relevance is known. Maintenance may mark redundancy, contradiction, or obsolescence while retaining original evidence, and textual abstraction can be escalated to an LLM.
blocks.zh: 收到的意见保留了原文和来源。 控制器对重叠的内存特性进行注释,而确定矢量,词典,实体,和时间搜索则产生一组有界限的候选邻居. 控制者然后判断关系;阈值决定添加哪些边. 可靠的时间戳命令和精确的识别码可以通过代码直接处理. 因此,正常的写入路径并不要求模型在得知未来的相关性之前不可逆转地丢弃观测. 维护可能在保留原始证据的同时标注冗余,矛盾或过时,文字抽象可以升级为LLM.

blocks.en: Given a query, the controller predicts relevant relation views, multi-hop needs, and recency, which guide budget allocation. Hybrid vector and lexical retrieval supplies anchors. During retrieval, the controller assesses whether accumulated evidence is sufficient and whether further expansion is likely to help. If needed and within budget, bounded graph expansion proposes candidates, which are scored and added to the evidence set. The loop stops on sufficient evidence, low expected additional benefit, or a resource limit. Selected memories then go to the LLM for answer synthesis. The controller affects evidence acquisition; it does not replace the final generative answerer.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一个查询,控制器会预测相关关系视图,多跳需求和复健,以指导预算分配. 混合矢量和词汇检索提供锚。 在检索过程中,控制器评估积累的证据是否足够,以及进一步扩展是否可能有所帮助. 如有必要,在预算范围内,扩大界限的图表提出候选人,这些候选人被评分,并加进成套证据。 循环在充分证据、低预期的额外效益或资源限制的基础上停止。 所选择的记忆然后到LLM进行解答合成. 控制器会影响证据获取;它不会取代最终的基因解答器.

blocks.en: The reported evaluation uses LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini as the answer model and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. These results concern Jev-based control on LoCoMo and do not evaluate the Laya controller or LongMemEval configuration provided by the implementation. 16 16 16 Jev-Mem implementation: https://github.com/libingzheren/Jev-Mem . Separating write and read control is particularly useful for attribution: changing stored relations can affect later answers even if the query-time controller is held fixed.
blocks.zh: 所报告的评价使用以GPT-4o-mini为答案模型的LoCoMo和LLM-as-a-Judge评分。 这些结果涉及基于Jev对LoCoMo的控制,不评估执行所提供的Laya控制器或LongMemEval配置。 16 16 Jev-Mem执行:https://github.com/libingzheren/Jev-Mem。 分离写和读控对归属特别有用: 改变存储关系会影响以后的答案,即使查询时间控制器被固定.

blocks.en: SAG2 instead starts from a local SQLite FTS5/BM25 index, without corpus-time embeddings or a neighbor graph ( Wu, 2026 ) . Jev makes a binary Noul judgment about each passage’s necessary contribution to a supported answer chain, conditioned on the retrieved evidence. This is not a single global Choice over passages. Ordinary code extracts lexical expansion terms from scored seed passages; retrieval and evidence-conditioned rescoring can repeat within a bounded budget. Local diversification then produces the final evidence set. The experiments evaluate retrieval rather than generated answers, and development includes MuSiQue and a synthetic enterprise corpus. The local index does not make the complete system local, because the evidence scorer uses the hosted Jev service. Relative to Jev-Mem, the intervention moves from constructing and traversing stored relations to building query-time evidence chains through lexical expansion.
blocks.zh: SAG2取而代之的是本地的SQLite FTS5/BM25指数,没有实体时嵌入或邻图(Wu,2026). Jev对每个段落对支持的回答链的必要贡献做出二进制的Noul判断,条件是要收集证据。 这不是一个单一的全球选择。 普通代码从得分的种子段落中摘录出词汇扩展词;检索和有证据条件的复分可以在限定的预算范围内重复. 然后,地方多样化产生最后证据。 实验评价检索,而不是生成答案,开发包括MuSiQue和一个合成企业体。 本地指数不会使完整的系统本地化,因为证据计分器使用主机Jev服务. 相对于Jev-Mem,干预从构建和翻转存储的关系转向通过扩展词汇构建查询时间证据链.

blocks.en: E.3 Decision Models in Agent Learning
blocks.zh: E.3 代理学习决策模式

blocks.en: A fixed decision service can also change an agent’s exploration, rewards, or updates during learning. Any resulting benefit may persist in the trained agent after the service is removed. This differs from fitting a replacement decision model to service outputs, as in Appendix C.3 , where training changes the model that will answer future decision requests. The relevant distinction is which model learns from the service and what it learns to do.
blocks.zh: 固定决策服务也可以改变代理人在学习过程中的探索、奖励或更新。 在解除服务后,受过培训的代理人可继续享受任何由此产生的福利。 这不同于采用替代决定模式为产出提供服务,如附录C.3,其中培训改变了模式,将回应今后的决定要求。 相关的区别在于哪个模式从服务中学习,以及它学会做什么.

blocks.en: Ma et al. (2026b) use Jev as an action-policy reference, an exploration source, an auxiliary reward assessor, and a replay-priority signal. These interventions change an agent’s data or updates, so their success is measured in the learned agent. AutoTrust instead fits a replacement decision model to Jev’s probability outputs, making reproduction of the teacher’s predictions a training target.
blocks.zh: Ma et al. (2026b)将Jev作为行动政策参考,探索源,辅助奖励评估员,以及重播优先信号. 这些干预措施改变了代理人的数据或更新,因此其成功与否由学习的代理人衡量. AutoTrust更符合Jev的概率输出的替换决定模型,使教师预测的复制成为培训目标.

blocks.en: The interventions have different semantics. Policy assistance supplies actions that can be imitated or compared with the learner’s actions by a critic. Exploration assistance replaces some random actions with Jev suggestions. Reward assistance maps rubric judgments to bonuses or gates. Replay assistance reweights stored experience using Jev judgments. The reported replay variant omits importance correction and therefore intentionally changes the effective training weighting. None of these roles makes an ordinal judgment a validated cardinal Q-value merely by converting its label to a number.
blocks.zh: 干预语义不同. 政策援助提供的行动可以模仿或比照批评家的学习行为。 勘探援助用Jev的建议取代一些随机行动。 奖励援助地图 标注判断 奖金或大门。 重放援助使用Jev判断重估存储的经验. 所报告的重播变体省略了重要性校正,因此有意改变有效的训练权重. 这些角色中没有一个只是通过将其标签转换成数字而使一个经验证的Q值基本值成为正文判断。

blocks.en: Information access also matters: Jev can receive structured descriptions beyond the learner’s own observation, and the trained learner can later be deployed without Jev or its auxiliary rewards. The paper’s MiniGrid and Atari experiments provide evidence for particular learning interventions, with three seeds; replay assistance does not uniformly help. The resulting gains or losses concern how the service changes learning. They cannot be attributed to the quality of its decision probabilities without separating added information, changed exploration, and changed objectives.
blocks.zh: 信息获取也事关: Jev可以得到超出学习者自身观察的结构化描述,经过训练的学习者可以在以后被部署,而不需要Jev或其辅助奖励. 论文的MiniGrid和Atari实验为具体的学习干预提供了证据,有三种种子;重播援助并不一致。 由此产生的损益涉及服务如何改变学习。 如果不区分所增加的信息、改变勘探方式和改变目标,就不能把它们归咎于其决定概率的质量。

blocks.en: Dyad spans both levels in a different way ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) . Its language model retains token generation and switches to a typed action distribution at designated interaction positions. The model aligns state and action representations through projector training, then applies environment-reward policy optimization over token and action decisions. Its action encoder may be updated alone or jointly with the state encoder. Action features are reusable only while their environment context and descriptions remain unchanged. Thus the learned architecture belongs to model construction, while the interleaving of language and environment actions defines the downstream workflow; it is not simply a frozen service plugged into another learner.
blocks.zh: Dyad以不同方式跨越两种水平(Zhan等人,2026年)。 其语言模型保留了符号生成,并切换到指定交互位置的输入动作分布. 该模式通过投影仪培训来协调状态和行动表述,然后将环境奖励政策优化于象征性决定和行动决定。 它的动作编码器可能单独更新或与州编码器联合更新. 行动特性只有在其环境背景和描述保持不变的情况下才能重复使用。 因此,学习的架构属于模型构建,而语言与环境行动的交互作用则定义了下游工作流程;它不仅仅是一个被插入到另一个学习者的冻结服务.

blocks.en: Appendix F From Local Probabilities to Workflow Reliability
blocks.zh: 附录F 从当地概率到工作流量可靠性

blocks.en: A candidate distribution, the action selected from it, and the outcome of a complete task require different evaluations. Accurate probabilities can yield a poor action under an unsuitable decision rule; a correct local action can still fail to secure task success. Our experiment measures selections, leaving calibration and downstream utility unresolved. The studies below identify the evidence needed to connect these levels.
blocks.zh: 候选人分配、从中选择的行动以及一项完整任务的结果需要不同的评价。 在不适当的决策规则下,准确的概率可能导致行动不力;正确的当地行动仍不能确保任务的成功。 我们的实验测量选择, 留下校准和下游的效用未解决。 以下研究确定了将这些水平联系起来所需的证据。

blocks.en: F.1 Local Probability Quality and Decision Utility
blocks.zh: F.1 当地概率质量和决定效用

blocks.en: Ordinary calibration compares reported probabilities with outcome frequencies among cases receiving the same predicted probabilities. Subgroup calibration additionally requires this agreement within specified groups. Distribution fidelity instead asks whether the complete prediction matches the conditional target for each input. Neither calibration nor fidelity alone specifies the action taken or the cost of an error. A decision rule converts probabilities into behavior, so a utility improvement can arise from a better distribution, a better rule, or both. Comparisons must separate these changes before attributing a gain to learning.
blocks.zh: 普通校准将报告概率与结果频率进行比较,在预测概率相同的病例中。 分组校准工作还要求在特定群体内达成这项协议。 相反,分配忠贞度询问,完整的预测是否与每项输入的有条件目标相符。 既不是校准,也不是忠贞本身就规定了所采取的行动或错误的代价。 一个决定规则可以将概率转换为行为,因此一个效用的改进可以从更好的分配,更好的规则,或者两者兼而有之. 比较必须将这些变化区分开来,然后才能使学习受益。

blocks.en: ProbabilityBench supplies simulated problems with a known conditional distribution p ∗ p^{*} given the visible input ( Dai et al., 2026 ) . This permits direct comparison with p ∗ p^{*} , rather than treating one sampled answer as the complete probability target. Accuracy evaluated in expectation under these conditional targets is bounded by the Bayes accuracy for the same visible information. Accuracy against sampled test labels can exceed that reference through label-sampling noise. For a predicted distribution q q , the input-averaged KL ( p ∗ ∥ q ) \mathrm{KL}(p^{*}\|q) equals excess expected log loss relative to p ∗ p^{*} . A constant class prior satisfies ordinary calibration while ignoring input-specific information, and need not be calibrated within subgroups. Finite-bin estimates can also hide canceling errors or reflect sampling noise. Exact uncertainty in a synthetic generator is therefore valuable evidence about probability estimation, but does not establish access to the true uncertainty of an arbitrary real task.
blocks.zh: 概率奔驰供应以已知的有条件分配方式模拟问题p * p^{*},考虑到可见输入(Dai等人,2026年). 这样可以直接与p * p 比较,而不是将一个抽样答案作为完全概率目标. 根据这些条件指标对预期值进行的准确性评价,以同一可见信息的贝叶斯准确度为界。 对抽样测试标签的精确度可通过标签抽样噪声超过该参考值。 对于预测的分布 q q,输入平均值 KL (p * Q q)\mathrm{KL}(p^{*}\|q) 等于相对于 p * p 的超预期日志损失. 常数类先满足普通校准,同时忽略输入特定信息,不需要在分组内校准. 限量-bin估计也可以隐藏取消错误或反映采样噪音. 因此,合成生成器中的确切不确定性是概率估计的宝贵证据,但并不能确定能否获得任意真实任务的真正不确定性。

blocks.en: SanSi provides a concrete example of why compute allocation and probability quality must be evaluated together ( Gan et al., 2026 ) . Its later loops continue to increase confidence even after most answers have stabilized. On the 9,645 answerable test items, the 1.4B model’s expected calibration error rises from 0.082 ± 0.010 0.082\pm 0.010 at loop three to 0.093 ± 0.012 0.093\pm 0.012 at loop eight. These are means and standard deviations over three training seeds, using ten equal-width confidence bins. The comparison concerns different readout depths within each trained model. It shows that additional latent computation can worsen calibration even within the trained loop range, so a stopping rule needs evidence for the probability or decision objective it serves.
blocks.zh: SanSi提供了一个具体的例子,说明为什么计算分配和概率质量必须一起评估(Gan等人,2026年)。 即使在大多数答案稳定下来之后,其后来的循环继续增强信心。 在9,645个可答测试项目上,1.4B模型的预期校准误差从环三的0.082±0.010 0.082\pm0.010上升到环八的0.093±0.012 0.093\pm0.012. 这些是三种训练种子的手段和标准偏差,使用10个等宽置信箱. 比较涉及每个训练有素模型的不同读取深度。 它表明,额外的潜在计算即使在训练有素的循环范围内也会使校准恶化,因此停止规则需要证明它所服务的概率或决定目标.

blocks.en: TypedBench complements this view with policy-generated cases, controlled framing changes, and cost-sensitive evaluation ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) . Its calibration and stress-test protocols distinguish benign framing sensitivity from adversarial perturbation. A change from argmax to the Bayes action under a cost matrix changes the decision rule; the resulting utility improvement cannot all be credited to better calibration. Synthetic labels make some controls possible while limiting direct conclusions about unconstrained natural tasks.
blocks.zh: Typed Bench用政策产生的案例、有控制的框架变化和对成本敏感的评价来补充这一观点(Sharma等人,2026年)。 其校准和压力测试协议将良性框架敏感性与对抗性扰动区分开来. 费用矩阵下从argmax到Bayes行动的改变改变了决定规则;由此产生的公用事业改进不能全部归结为更好的校准。 合成标签使得一些控制成为可能,同时限制对不受约束的自然任务的直接结论.

blocks.en: Published scores differ in both what they measure and how evaluation informs model development. JEVal supplies a benchmark as well as the SII model discussed in Appendix C.3 , but the SII release’s separate evaluation suite does not reproduce that benchmark protocol ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . Inner Jev’s Capability metric differs from ordinary accuracy, and its OpenDecisions results inform recipe selection ( Geuter et al., 2026 ) . LLM-as-Jev likewise uses public JevBench errors to guide data-mixture development ( Li and Wagle, 2026 ) . Metric definitions and evaluation feedback must therefore be accounted for before these scores can support a common ranking.
blocks.zh: 公布的评分在衡量和评价如何为模型开发提供信息方面各不相同。 JEVal提供了附录C.3中讨论的基准和SII模型,但SII发行的单独评价套件并没有复制该基准协议(Duan等人,2026年)。 内杰夫的能力度量不同于普通的准确性,其开放决定结果为食谱选择提供了依据(Geuter等人,2026年). LLM-as-Jev同样使用公开的Jev Bench错误来指导数据混合开发(Li and Wagle, 2026年). 因此,在这些分数能够支持共同排名之前,必须考虑到计量定义和评价反馈。

blocks.en: Data overlap and execution conditions further limit comparisons. FunDM’s reproduction notes disclose overlap between a CLM post-training collection and its test collection. Local-model and hosted-API latency also reflect different hardware and network conditions. Generalization and efficiency claims therefore require controls beyond matching the reported metric.
blocks.zh: 数据重叠和执行条件进一步限制了比较。 FunDM的复制笔记披露了培训后的CLM收藏与其测试收藏之间的重叠. 本地型和主机-API latency也反映了不同的硬件和网络条件. 因此,一般化和效率索赔要求的控制超出了所报告衡量标准。

blocks.en: F.2 Composition and Input Sensitivity
blocks.zh: F.2 构成和投入敏感性

blocks.en: An isolated prediction tests one input and output interface. Composing predictions introduces dependencies; changing a request can alter evidence, eligible actions, or numerical computation. Interpreting sensitivity first requires specifying what should remain invariant. Our permutations preserve question content and candidate identities, whereas adding a candidate or revealing evidence can change the decision problem.
blocks.zh: 一个孤立的预测测试了一个输入和输出接口. 构建预测引入了依赖性;更改请求可以改变证据,符合条件的行动,或数字计算. 解释敏感性首先需要具体说明哪些内容应保持不变。 我们的布局保留了问题内容和候选人身份,而增加候选人或披露证据则可以改变决定问题。

blocks.en: Coherence studies test probability relationships across related questions ( Joy, 2026 ) , while option-set studies test how predictions respond to changed alternatives ( Rajput et al., 2026 ) . Neither relationship follows from calibration on isolated questions.
blocks.zh: 一致性研究测试跨相关问题的概率关系(Joy, 2026),而选项设定研究测试预测如何响应改变的替代品(Rajput等人, 2026). 两者关系都不是通过对孤立问题的校准而产生的。

blocks.en: Chen (2026) distinguishes changes to the questions bundled into a request, the evidence provided, and the eligible candidates. A model whose question compiler produces exactly the same input can be invariant for that reason, whereas a full-schema prompt exposes other questions to the decision computation. The Nimble intervention removes other questions from the prompt and eliminates the observed flips, but is not length-matched. Small Laya shifts largely disappear at higher precision or after rounding. The observed sensitivity can therefore reflect prompt construction or numerical precision as well as architectural dependencies. Conditional odds between retained alternatives separate genuine relative-score movement from the inevitable change in a softmax denominator. When a readout restricts the vocabulary, its allowed-label mass provides additional information lost by normalization.
blocks.zh: 陈(2026年)区分了对被捆绑在请求,提供的证据,以及合格候选人的问题的修改. 问题编译器产生完全相同的输入的模型可能因此变化不定,而全程速率则会在决定计算中暴露出其他问题. 尼姆布尔语干预将其他问题从即时解脱,并消除观察到的翻转,但是没有长度匹配. 小的Laya转动在更精确或四舍五入后基本消失. 因此,所观察到的敏感性可以反映迅速的构造或数字精确度以及建筑依赖性。 保留替代品之间的有条件差异将真正的相对分数运动与软度分母的必然变化分开。 当读出限制词汇时,其允许的标签质量提供了因正常化而损失的额外信息.

blocks.en: Choice2Seq compares native candidate choice with independent-position and serial-prefix output interfaces on paired problems ( Lai et al., 2026 ) . Its serial correctness retention is P ⁡ ( serial correct ∣ native correct ) P(\text{serial correct}\mid\text{native correct}) , not agreement with the native answer or fidelity to a plan. Cases improved by the serial interface and the marginal accuracies are needed alongside this conditional statistic. Gold-copy and self-plan controls address different fidelity questions. Candidate restrictions can also change the available search space and number of calls, so a composition claim requires the relevant interface and information controls.
blocks.zh: 选择2 Seq 将本地候选人选择与独立位置和串行前缀输出界面在配对问题上进行比较 (Lai等人,2026年). 它的序列正确性保留是 P QQ( 序列正确 QQ 原生正确 ) P(\ text{serial right}\ mid\ text{ nature right}), 而不是同意原生的答案或对计划的忠诚 。 需要通过序列接口和边际速率改进案件,同时提供这种有条件的统计数据。 黄金拷贝和自我计划控制处理不同的忠诚问题。 候选限制还可以改变现有的搜索空间和呼叫次数,因此一个组成主张需要相关的接口和信息控制.

blocks.en: Robustness studies connect input sensitivity to the consequences of a valid but incorrect choice. DecisionRobust tests label-preserving perturbations and targeted prompt injection on initially correct decisions across text and vision ( Lan et al., 2026 ) . The distinction between observation text and task instructions matters because changing task facts would change the decision problem itself. JevProbe traces the structured response through application logic and tests whether reachable lower-trust context can redirect a program decision while leaving task facts and code fixed ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Together, these studies show why schema validity is insufficient for reliable execution. They identify failures of input handling and decision use, with modeled program consequences rather than measured real-world losses.
blocks.zh: 强性研究将输入敏感性与有效但错误的选择的后果联系起来. 第Robust号决定测试了保留标签的扰动,并有针对性地迅速注入最初正确决定的文本和视野(Lan等人,2026年)。 意见案文和任务指示之间的区别很重要,因为改变任务事实将改变决定问题本身。 JevProbe通过应用逻辑和测试来跟踪结构化的响应,通过应用逻辑和测试可达的低信任上下文能否在任务事实和代码固定的同时重定向程序决定(Luo等人,2026年). 这些研究加在一起说明了为什么计划的有效性不足以可靠地执行. 它们找出输入处理和决策使用方面的失败,具有模拟程序后果,而不是衡量现实世界的损失。

blocks.en: TUPLE-Bench studies whether a response about an authorized coarse category reveals a protected finer mechanism in the model’s private evidence ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Choice-only, confidence, full-probability, and native-response releases are derived from the same saved response, separating release policy from model reruns. Its informed decoder receives the gold coarse category and two known fine-grained hypotheses; this is a passive closed-set audit, not an estimate of unrestricted real-world leakage. A separate legitimate consumer sees neither private evidence nor those hidden labels. The proposed workflow-conditioned probability quantization selects codewords that preserve a frozen consumer’s actions, including clarification, with a native-response fallback when no match exists. It can preserve wrong actions as well as correct ones, so action preservation establishes neither improved task quality nor a confidentiality guarantee. The contribution concerns evaluation and release postprocessing, not a new decision-model training objective.
blocks.zh: TUPLE-Bench研究关于授权粗细类的答复是否揭示了模型的私人证据中受保护的精细机制(Yang等人,2026年)。 唯一选择,自信,完全概率,以及本体反应的释放都是从同一个保存的响应中衍生出来的,将释放政策与模型重运行分开. 其知情的解码器接收黄金粗细分类和两种已知的精细的假说;这是被动的闭合设置审计,而不是对无限制真实世界渗漏的估计. 一个单独的合法消费者既不看到私人证据,也不看到这些隐藏的标签。 拟议的工作流程附带条件的概率量化选择了保护被冻结的消费者行为,包括澄清的密码词,在不存在匹配时则会回落。 它可以保存错误的行动以及正确的行动,因此,保存行动既不能提高任务质量,也不能保证保密。 该贡献涉及评价和发布后处理,而不是一项新的决策模式培训目标。

blocks.en: F.3 Complete-Workflow Outcomes
blocks.zh: F.3 工作流程结果

blocks.en: Ling et al. (2026b) separate changes to the action interface from changes to the decision model in ALFWorld. They compare the original baseline, an LLM using a Choice interface, and Jev using that interface. The first contrast examines the candidate-selection interface; the second compares decision components within it. Their AndroidWorld experiments compare baseline and Jev integrations without this three-way control. Across these workflows, local decision savings do not uniformly translate into better task outcomes. Action granularity also differs in one integration: FastAgent-J takes one tool action per step while its baseline can take multiple actions. The study thus provides evidence about particular integrations while illustrating the controls needed to interpret them.
blocks.zh: Ling等人(2026b)在ALFWorld中将动作界面的改变与决定模型的改变分开. 他们比较了原始基线,使用选择界面的LLM,Jev使用该接口. 第一种对比审查候选人-选任界面;第二种对比其中的决定部分。 他们的AndroidWorld实验比较基线和Jev集成时没有这种三向控制. 在这些工作流程中,地方决策的节省并没有统一转化为更好的任务成果。 行动颗粒性在一种整合中也有所不同: FastAgent-J每步采取一个工具动作,而其基线可以采取多个动作. 因此,该研究提供了具体整合的证据,同时说明了解释这些整合所需的控制措施。

blocks.en: JevAgentHarness distinguishes isolated multiple-choice accuracy, decisions on recorded agent states without execution, and actual closed-loop intervention ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Its closed-loop tool-selection comparison lets the LLM supply tool arguments and uses unthresholded replacement. That protocol differs from the confidence cascade proposed for deployment, so its outcomes cannot be attributed directly to that cascade. Scripted acceptable actions in DecisionGym and disjoint rollout seeds also do not, by themselves, establish generalization to unseen task distributions.
blocks.zh: JevAgentHarness区分了孤立的多选择精度,关于记录的代理状态的决定没有执行,以及实际的闭路干预(Zhu等人,2026a). 其闭路工具选择比较让LLM提供工具参数,并使用无门槛替换. 该议定书不同于拟议部署的信任级联,因此其结果不能直接归因于该级联。 在“决定Gym”和“脱节”推出的种子中编订的可接受的行动本身也无法将任务分配普遍化。

blocks.en: System1-Arena broadens the comparison across static decisions and closed-loop environments under task-specific shared harnesses ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . Candidate construction converts otherwise open-ended search, patches, or arguments into finite alternatives; the reported results are conditional on this interface. The static comparison uses 85,305 questions across 94 tasks, a subset of the released collection, and excludes its game and embodied questions. Reported static scores weight tasks equally, with source averaging within a task. Closed-loop scores weight environments equally. For real-time simulations, the environment advances using each model’s measured median latency while retaining the prior action, rather than measuring each call’s realized delay inside the simulation. Probability extraction also differs across native decision models, verbalized-probability APIs, and local label-logit models. These protocol choices enable useful controlled comparisons while limiting a universal ranking across interfaces, hardware, and workloads.
blocks.zh: System1-Arena在任务专用共享带下拓宽了静态决定和闭路环境之间的比较(Chen等人,2026a )。 候选构建将否则可开放的搜索,补丁,或参数转换为有限替代品;报告的结果以此接口为条件. 静态比较使用共94项任务的85,305个问题,这是发行的集合的一个子集,并排除了它的游戏和包含的问题. 报告静态计分权重任务相等,而源平均值在任务之内. 闭路对重量环境的分数相等。 就实时模拟而言,环境利用每个模型的测得的中位延迟度,同时保留先前的动作,而不是测量每个呼叫在模拟中实现的延迟。 概率提取在本土决策模型,口头化-概率API,以及本地标签-logit模型之间也有差异. 这些协议选择可以进行有益的控制比较,同时限制跨越接口、硬件和工作量的普遍排名。

blocks.en: Ecosystem studies explain where decision models are used, but do not replace these capability and workflow evaluations. Ling et al. (2026a) analyze public Jev repositories by application domain and decision purpose. Purposes can overlap within a project, and repository counts or stars measure ecosystem activity rather than model quality or methodological novelty. Tang and Zheng (2026) audit early typed-decision-model evidence and connect it to label-probability readouts, reranking, calibration, and model cascades.
blocks.zh: 生态系统研究解释了使用何种决策模式,但并不取代这些能力和工作流程评价。 Ling等人(2026a)根据应用领域和决定目的分析公共Jev寄存器. 目的可在项目内重叠,储存点数或恒星衡量生态系统活动,而不是模型质量或方法创新。 唐和 Zheng(2026年)审计早期的打字决定模型证据,并将其与标签概率读取,重排,校准,以及模型级联连接起来.

blocks.en: Appendix G Open Questions
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en: The unresolved question is which design changes preserve correct choices across equivalent presentations. The comparisons below separate representation, learning, computation, and workflow effects so that any improvement can be attributed to a specified intervention.
blocks.zh: 尚未解决的问题是,哪些设计上的改变保留了对等列报的正确选择。 在单独的表述、学习、计算和工作流程效应下进行的比较,可以将任何改进归因于特定的干预。

blocks.en: Takeaways F.1 and F.2 distinguish local probability quality from consistency across requests. The main study finds substantially more Jev variation under reordering than under fixed-order repetition, without identifying the mechanism behind this difference. Independent studies examine disagreement between direct and hierarchical predictions ( Joy, 2026 ) , option-set dependence ( Rajput et al., 2026 ) , serial correctness retention ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , and the limited transfer of local savings to successful agent outcomes ( Ling et al., 2026b ) . Together, they motivate testing whether a local probability improvement persists under transformations that preserve the intended decision problem and predicts utility in a fixed workflow. The intended invariance must be specified first. Independence of irrelevant alternatives is not universally appropriate, since an added option may provide meaningful context or change the task. Prompt serialization and precision require controls ( Chen, 2026 ) , while cacheability must be separated from set-dependent refinement ( Li and Wang, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 外购F.1和F.2区分了当地概率质量和各种请求的一致性。 主要研究发现,在重排时Jev的变异比固定重排时多得多,没有找出这种差异背后的机制. 独立研究考察了直接预测和分级预测之间的分歧(Joy, 2026),选项设置依赖(Rajput等人, 2026),序列正确性保留(Lai等人, 2026),以及将当地节余有限地转移到成功的代理结果(Ling等人, 2026b). 它们共同激励人们测试,在保留预期决策问题的变革中,当地概率是否继续提高,并预测固定工作流程中的效用。 首先必须具体说明意图的不变化。 不相关的备选办法的独立性并非普遍合适,因为增加一个备选办法可能提供有意义的背景或改变任务。 即时序列化和精度要求控制(Chen, 2026),而可缓存性则必须和自定依赖的完善(Li和Wang, 2026)分开.

blocks.en: Takeaway C.4 separates statistical supervision from the variable receiving gradient credit. Replacing observed labels with teacher distributions changes the target; adding output noise can replace an unperturbed score with its expectation under perturbation. An estimator comparison therefore requires a fixed objective and perturbation distribution, with pathwise differentiation and score-function credit compared where both apply. Matching the backbone, prompt, candidates, examples, adaptation budget, and validation split would isolate this question, with frozen and temperature-calibrated readouts as starting controls. Whether a gain survives common calibration and probability postprocessing would help establish its source. A negative result would delimit the value of a specified stochastic update without resolving how proprietary Jev is trained.
blocks.zh: Takeaway C.4将统计监督与接受梯度信用的变量区分开来. 用老师分布来取代观测到的标签会改变目标;加上输出噪声可以取代在扰动下其预期值的未扰动分数. 因此,进行估算比较需要有固定的目标和扰动分布,在两者都适用的情况下,有路径的区分和记分功能信用。 匹配骨干、即时、候选、实例、适应预算以及验证的划分将孤立这一问题,将冷冻和温度校准的读出作为起始控制。 收益是否在普通的校准和后处理中存活下来将有助于确定其来源。 负面结果将限定特定结构更新的值,而不解决如何培训专有Jev的问题。

blocks.en: Takeaways C.3 and D.1 distinguish the information supplied during learning from the computation available at inference. JEVal reports that reasoning-to-readout transfer differs between evidence-weighing and computation-heavy tasks ( Duan et al., 2026 ) ; earlier System 2 distillation also documents task-dependent transfer ( Yu et al., 2024 ) . Conversely, theoretical work shows that some computations can be internalized under particular architectures and curricula ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . The unresolved empirical question concerns the interaction of training support, novel rule composition, and dependency depth. Correct-label supervision, additional data, intermediate-state hints, and explicit-reasoning controls would help distinguish imperfect targets and learning limitations from residual computational demands. Failure on a task family alone does not prove an impossibility of single-pass reasoning.
blocks.zh: 外购C.3和D.1将学习期间提供的信息与推断时可用的计算区分开来。 JEVal报道说,推理到读转录的任务在证据维度和计算重度任务之间有所不同(Duan等人,2026年);早期的System 2蒸馏也记录了依赖于任务的转录(Yu等人,2024年). 相反,理论工作表明,某些计算可以在特定的架构和课程下内部化(Huang等人,2026年)。 尚未解决的经验问题涉及培训支助、新规则构成和依赖深度之间的相互作用。 正确标签监督、额外数据、中间状态提示和明确的理由控制将有助于区分不完善的目标和学习限制以及剩余计算需求。 单靠一个任务家庭的失败并不能证明单程推理是不可能的。

blocks.en: Takeaways E.1 – E.3 identify where a model intervenes; Takeaway F.3 shows why that intervention matters for evaluation. A comparison within a fixed workflow can replace only the decision component while holding candidate construction, retrieval, budgets, fallback rules, and answer generation constant. A complementary comparison retains the same model while changing its role or control policy. Jev-Mem motivates separating write control from read control; run selection requires matching candidate-run generation; LAVOIR requires accounting for newly acquired information and the cost of questions. Crossing model and workflow choices can reveal whether local probability improvements transfer to task outcomes and how that transfer depends on the surrounding policy. Existing evidence does not establish that either model quality or workflow design universally dominates.
blocks.zh: Takeaways E.1 – E.3 确定一个模型干预的地方; Takeaway F.3 显示为什么该干预对评价很重要。 固定工作流程内的比较只能取代决策部分,同时保持候选构建、检索、预算、倒置规则和回答生成常数。 补充性比较在改变其作用或控制政策的同时保留了同样的模式。 Jev-Mem激励将写控与读控区分开来;运行选择需要匹配候选人运行的生成;LAVOIR需要核算新获得的信息和问题的成本. 跨模式和工作流程选择可以揭示地方概率改进是否转移到任务成果,以及这种转移如何取决于周围的政策。 现有证据并未确定模型质量或工作流程设计普遍占主导地位。

blocks.en: These factors can interact. Establishing a structural advantage requires identifying both the intervention and the conditions under which its benefit survives.
blocks.zh: 这些因素可以相互作用。 建立结构优势需要确定干预及其利益生存的条件。

blocks.en: A candidate-distribution interface accommodates different representations, objectives, gradient estimators, inference procedures, and downstream roles. The main study shows that this shared interface does not ensure preservation of correct choices under reordering. Explaining the observed differences requires controlled comparisons under common information and resource budgets, followed by tests of whether local improvements benefit the workflow the model controls.
blocks.zh: 候选人-分配接口可容纳不同的表述、目标、梯度估计、推论程序和下游角色。 主要研究表明,这种共享界面并不能确保在重排时保持正确的选择. 解释观察到的差异需要在共同信息和资源预算下进行有控制的比较,然后测试当地改进是否有利于模型控制的工作流程。

blocks.en: Cloudflare Clef attaches a small transformer joint schema head to Qwen3.8-27B. Its card describes all-question probabilities from one forward pass, an expected-value scalar score, and backbone, head and inference artifacts, but not the exact post-training objective. pplx-decider-v1.1-27b uses a separate 255 × 5120 255\times 5120 readout, noncausal full-attention layers with unchanged linear-attention behavior, and saved temperature calibration. Its training loss and update method remain unspecified. These interfaces alone establish neither RL nor supervised training.
blocks.zh: 云飞 Clef将一个小变压器联动计头附在Quen3.8-27B上. 它的卡片描述了从一个前传,一个预期价值的标分,以及骨干,头部和推论文物,但并非准确的训练后目标,产生的全问题概率. pplx-decider-v1.1-27b使用单独的255×5120 255\times 5120读出,无因子全心全意层,具有不变的线性注意行为,并节省温度校准. 其培训损失和更新方法仍未说明。 仅靠这些接口既不建立RL,也不建立监督培训。

blocks.en: imajev documents language LoRA with frozen vision and weight-space averaging of a hard-question adapter with its soft-target continuation. jqv offers frozen-logit backends and trainable slot or pointer heads with LoRA and CE plus Brier loss. openJev-verdict describes a marker-pointer distribution head, an out-of-fold confidence head, and symmetric KL between option-shuffled training pairs.
blocks.zh: imajev 记录语言 LORA , 显示一个硬质问题适配器的冷冻视觉和平均重量空间及其软目标续作。 jqv提供冷冻-logit后端和可训练插槽或指针头与LORA和CE+Brier损失. openJev-verdict描述了一个标记点分布头,一个外倍置信头,以及选项洗牌训练对称KL.

blocks.en: Other designs vary the candidate representation. jevlike learns option-conditioned context scoring with either a learned byte encoder or a frozen pretrained encoder. agent-jev combines independent candidate paths with a permutation-equivariant scoring head and documents soft CE plus Brier training for AgentJev-0.6B. GLiNER2.5-Decide publishes supervised fine-tuning formats and procedures, but the objective used for its released weights remains unspecified. jev-local offers an optional frozen-model log-probability scorer and a deterministic default stub; head training is explicitly deferred.
blocks.zh: 其他设计则改变了候选人的代表性。 Jevlike学习可选条件上下文的评分,要么是学习到的字节编码器,要么是被冻结的预先训练的编码器. 代理-jev将独立的候选路径与一个固定-等分的积分头结合,并为代理Jev-0.6B编写文件软CE+Brier训练. GLiNER2.5-Decide发布有监督的微调格式和程序,但其释放权重所使用的目标仍然不明. Jev-local提供可选的冷冻模型日志概率计分器和确定性的默认积分;头部培训被明确推迟。
